searchText: AD Connect同步规则 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure AD Section: KB 最近修改: 2023-11-16 15:47:28 JD 相关性: Azure AD 一句话摘要 查阅之后发现，客户的问题现象和下面极为相似： 问题现象 / 场景 查阅之后发现，客户的问题现象和下面极为相似： 背景信息 问题描述： 客户反馈其在使用AD Connect同步后，其同步到Azure AD的账户名有问题，参考工单“SR 2019042421576 [MS-LED]AD同步的账号自动会加一段到名字上”： 同步前： 同步后： AD Connect同步到Azure AD之后，在Azure AD中的@前面的部分“Ben.Zhang”莫名多了一部分“-linde-china.com”,即变为了“Ben.Zhang-linde-china.com” 很奇怪多出的这部分“-linde-china.com”是怎么来的呢？ 为什么会使用同步前的“mailNickname”字段作为同步后的账号名称@前部分？ 找到了问题原因，那怎么进行更新呢？ 客户：不对啊，我们之前的不是这样的呢，没有中间那部分… 后来客户聊到，给他发送部署文档的同事曾提到要设置什么同步规则，其具体的规则内容如下： Expression Alias Word([mail],1,"@") Expression UserPrincipalName IIF(IsPresent(Word([userPrincipalName],1,"@")),Word([userPrincipalName],1,"@") & "@lindexm.com", [userPrincipalName] & "@lindexm.com") ??????这东西没听说过啊？虽然看不懂设置的具体规则(后来查到这里的规则使用的是VB编程语言)，但是感觉上是为了解决上述问题的，所以赶紧让客户添加了下。 不料客户这边添加之后，仍然没有成功。。。 直到后来才发现，是客户添加的规则因为优先级的问题，导致规则并没有生效。那么如何判断这个规则的作用，其优先级又是怎样的呢？可以下面的链接文档： 同步规则的优先级，数值较小的同步规则具有较高的优先级。 启动同步规则编辑器： +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 同步规则具有四个配置部分：描述、范围筛选器、联接规则和转换。 说明 第一部分提供名称和说明等基本信息。 还可以看到此同步规则用于密码同步。如果用户在此同步规则的范围内，密码将从本地同步到云（假设已启用密码同步功能）。 范围筛选器 此规则用于定义哪些组应设置到 Azure AD。 通讯组必须启用邮件，才能与 Azure AD 同步，但对于安全组，电子邮件不是必需的。 联接规则 只对联接规则评估一次。 当连接器空间对象与 metaverse 对象联接在一起时，只要仍然满足同步规则的范围，它们就保持联接。 转换 转换可以具有不同类型：常量、指令和表达式。 直接流始终将源中的属性值按原样传递到目标属性。 第三种流类型是“表达式”，它允许进行更高级的配置。 复制 // If-then-else IIF( // (The evaluation for IIF) Is the attribute pwdLastSet present in AD? IsPresent([pwdLastSet]), // (The True part of IIF) If it is, then from right to left, convert the AD time format to a .Net datetime, change it to the time format used by Azure AD, and finally convert it to a string. CStr(FormatDateTime(DateFromNum([pwdLastSet]),"yyyyMMddHHmmss.0Z")), // (The False part of IIF) Nothing to contribute NULL ) 有关属性流表达式语言的详细信息，请参阅了解声明性预配表达式。 排查思路 仔细查看客户发过来的第一张截图发现，这多出来的部分不就是AD Connect同步前的“mailNickname”字段的内容嘛： 根据上面的排查，与客户沟通，根据默认的规则，您这边同步的显示是正常的。 如何设定同步规则？可以使用同步规则编辑器 (SRE) 工具来查看和更改配置，可以在开始菜单中找到其快捷方式。 SRE 是一个资源套件工具，随 Azure AD Connect 同步一起安装。必须是 ADSyncAdmins 组的成员才能启动它。 如我的测试环境中，可以按如下截图步骤找到同步规则编辑器： “范围筛选器”部分用于配置同步规则何时适用。 由于正在查看的同步规则的名称指示只应对已启用的用户应用该规则，因此对范围进行了配置，使得 AD 属性 userAccountControl 不能对 2 这个位进行设置。 同步引擎在 AD 中找到用户时，如果 userAccountControl 设置为十进制值 512（已启用的普通用户），则应用此同步规则。 如果用户的 userAccountControl 设置为 514（已禁用的普通用户），则不应用该规则。 第三部分用于配置连接器空间中的对象与 Metaverse 中的对象的相关性。 前面查看过的规则没有针对“联接规则”的任何配置，因此现在将查看“In from AD - User Join”。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 还可以找到以下相关信息：此规则与哪个已连接系统相关、此规则适合于已连接系统中的哪种对象类型，以及 metaverse 对象类型。 无论源对象类型是用户、iNetOrgPerson 还是联系人，metaverse 对象类型始终是人。 Metaverse 对象类型应该永不更改，因此将它创建为泛型类型。 可以将链接类型设置为“联接”、“StickyJoin”或“预配”。 此设置将与“联接规则”部分协同工作，稍后介绍此方面的内容。 范围筛选器具有可以嵌套的组和子句。 必须满足组内所有子句的条件，才能应用同步规则。 如果定义了多个组，则要应用该规则，必须满足至少一个组的条件。 也就是说，组之间按逻辑“或”进行计算，组内按逻辑“和”进行计算。 可以在出站同步规则“Out to AAD - Group Join”中找到此配置的示例。 有多个同步筛选器组，例如，一个用于安全组 (securityEnabled EQUAL True)，一个用于分发组 (securityEnabled EQUAL False)。 联接规则的内容取决于在安装向导中选择的匹配选项。 对于入站规则，评估从源连接器空间中的对象开始，将按顺序对联接规则中的每个组进行评估。 如果根据某个联接规则，某个源对象的评估结果是与 Metaverse 中的某个对象完全匹配，则这两个对象将联接在一起。 如果已对所有规则进行评估但没有匹配项，则使用描述页上的“链接类型”。 如果此配置设为“预配”，则在目标（即 Metaverse）中创建一个新对象。 投影 到 Metaverse。 评估同步规则时，必须只有一个定义了联接规则的同步规则在范围内。 如果一个对象找到多个包含联接规则的同步规则，则会引发错误。 因此最佳做法是，当一个对象有多个同步规则在范围内时，只让一个同步规则有定义的联接。 在 Azure AD Connect 同步的现成配置中，可以通过查看名称并查找在名称末尾带有单词 Join 的规则来找到这些规则。 如果另一个同步规则将对象联接在一起或在目标中预配了新对象，则未定义任何联接规则的同步规则将应用属性流。 查看上图，可以看到规则尝试将 objectSID 与 msExchMasterAccountSid (Exchange) 和 msRTCSIP-OriginatorSid (Lync) 相联接，而这正是我们在帐户资源林拓扑中所预期的。 会发现所有林具有相同的规则。 假设每个林可以是帐户或资源林。 如果有帐户存在于单个林中且不需要联接，此配置也能正常运行。 “转换”部分定义当对象已联接且满足范围筛选条件时，应用于目标对象的所有属性流。 回到“In from AD - User AccountEnabled”同步规则，找到以下转换： 如果将此配置放在帐户-资源林部署的上下文中，应在帐户林中找到已启用的帐户，在具有 Exchange 和 Lync 设置的资源林中找到已禁用的帐户。 查看的同步规则包含进行登录所需的属性，这些属性应从包含已启用帐户的林流动。 所有这些属性流会在一个同步规则中进行组合。 常量流始终传递硬编码值。 在上例中，始终将名为 accountEnabled 的 Metaverse 属性设置为 True 值。 表达式语言是 VBA (Visual Basic for Applications)，因此具有 Microsoft Office 或 VBScript 经验的用户认识该格式。 属性将括在方括号内，如 [attributeName]。 属性名称和函数名称是区分大小写的，但同步规则编辑器将对表达式求值并在表达式无效时提供警告。 所有表达式都使用嵌套函数表示在一行上。 为了显示配置语言的强大功能，下面给出了 pwdLastSet 流的示例，但插入了附加注释： 参考链接 在Azure官方文档中搜索“mailNickname”找到了这篇文档： 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2019/5/21 问题描述： 客户反馈其在使用AD IIF(IsPresent(Word([userPrincipalName],1,"@")),Word([userPrincipalName],1,"@") & "@lindexm.com", [userPrincipalName] & "@lindexm.com") ??????这东西没听说过啊？虽然看不懂设置的具体规则(后来查到这里的规则使用的是VB编程语言)，但是感觉上是为了解决上述问题的，所以赶紧让客户添加了下。 不料客户这边添加之后，仍然没有成功。。。 直到后来才发现，是客户添加的规则因为优先级的问题，导致规则并没有生效。那么如何判断这个规则的作用，其优先级又是怎样的呢？可以下面的链接文档： 同步规则的优先级，数值较小的同步规则具有较高的优先级。 如何设定同步规则？可以使用同步规则编辑器 (SRE) 工具来查看和更改配置，可以在开始菜单中找到其快捷方式。 SRE 是一个资源套件工具，随 Azure AD Connect 同步一起安装。必须是 ADSyncAdmins 组的成员才能启动它。 如我的测试环境中，可以按如下截图步骤找到同步规则编辑器： 启动同步规则编辑器： +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 同步规则具有四个配置部分：描述、范围筛选器、联接规则和转换。 说明 第一部分提供名称和说明等基本信息。 还可以找到以下相关信息：此规则与哪个已连接系统相关、此规则适合于已连接系统中的哪种对象类型，以及 metaverse 对象类型。 无论源对象类型是用户、iNetOrgPerson 还是联系人，metaverse 对象类型始终是人。 Metaverse 对象类型应该永不更改，因此将它创建为泛型类型。 可以将链接类型设置为“联接”、“StickyJoin”或“预配”。 此设置将与“联接规则”部分协同工作，稍后介绍此方面的内容。 还可以看到此同步规则用于密码同步。如果用户在此同步规则的范围内，密码将从本地同步到云（假设已启用密码同步功能）。 范围筛选器 “范围筛选器”部分用于配置同步规则何时适用。 由于正在查看的同步规则的名称指示只应对已启用的用户应用该规则，因此对范围进行了配置，使得 AD 属性 userAccountControl 不能对 2 这个位进行设置。 同步引擎在 AD 中找到用户时，如果 userAccountControl 设置为十进制值 512（已启用的普通用户），则应用此同步规则。 如果用户的 userAccountControl 设置为 514（已禁用的普通用户），则不应用该规则。 范围筛选器具有可以嵌套的组和子句。 必须满足组内所有子句的条件，才能应用同步规则。 如果定义了多个组，则要应用该规则，必须满足至少一个组的条件。 也就是说，组之间按逻辑“或”进行计算，组内按逻辑“和”进行计算。 可以在出站同步规则“Out to AAD - Group Join”中找到此配置的示例。 有多个同步筛选器组，例如，一个用于安全组 (securityEnabled EQUAL True)，一个用于分发组 (securityEnabled EQUAL False)。 此规则用于定义哪些组应设置到 Azure AD。 通讯组必须启用邮件，才能与 Azure AD 同步，但对于安全组，电子邮件不是必需的。 联接规则 第三部分用于配置连接器空间中的对象与 Metaverse 中的对象的相关性。 前面查看过的规则没有针对“联接规则”的任何配置，因此现在将查看“In from AD - User Join”。 联接规则的内容取决于在安装向导中选择的匹配选项。 对于入站规则，评估从源连接器空间中的对象开始，将按顺序对联接规则中的每个组进行评估。 如果根据某个联接规则，某个源对象的评估结果是与 Metaverse 中的某个对象完全匹配，则这两个对象将联接在一起。 如果已对所有规则进行评估但没有匹配项，则使用描述页上的“链接类型”。 如果此配置设为“预配”，则在目标（即 Metaverse）中创建一个新对象。 投影 到 Metaverse。 只对联接规则评估一次。 当连接器空间对象与 metaverse 对象联接在一起时，只要仍然满足同步规则的范围，它们就保持联接。 评估同步规则时，必须只有一个定义了联接规则的同步规则在范围内。 如果一个对象找到多个包含联接规则的同步规则，则会引发错误。 因此最佳做法是，当一个对象有多个同步规则在范围内时，只让一个同步规则有定义的联接。 在 Azure AD Connect 同步的现成配置中，可以通过查看名称并查找在名称末尾带有单词 Join 的规则来找到这些规则。 如果另一个同步规则将对象联接在一起或在目标中预配了新对象，则未定义任何联接规则的同步规则将应用属性流。 查看上图，可以看到规则尝试将 objectSID 与 msExchMasterAccountSid (Exchange) 和 msRTCSIP-OriginatorSid (Lync) 相联接，而这正是我们在帐户资源林拓扑中所预期的。 会发现所有林具有相同的规则。 假设每个林可以是帐户或资源林。 如果有帐户存在于单个林中且不需要联接，此配置也能正常运行。 转换 “转换”部分定义当对象已联接且满足范围筛选条件时，应用于目标对象的所有属性流。 回到“In from AD - User AccountEnabled”同步规则，找到以下转换： 如果将此配置放在帐户-资源林部署的上下文中，应在帐户林中找到已启用的帐户，在具有 Exchange 和 Lync 设置的资源林中找到已禁用的帐户。 查看的同步规则包含进行登录所需的属性，这些属性应从包含已启用帐户的林流动。 所有这些属性流会在一个同步规则中进行组合。 转换可以具有不同类型：常量、指令和表达式。 常量流始终传递硬编码值。 在上例中，始终将名为 accountEnabled 的 Metaverse 属性设置为 True 值。 直接流始终将源中的属性值按原样传递到目标属性。 第三种流类型是“表达式”，它允许进行更高级的配置。 表达式语言是 VBA (Visual Basic for Applications)，因此具有 Microsoft Office 或 VBScript 经验的用户认识该格式。 属性将括在方括号内，如 [attributeName]。 属性名称和函数名称是区分大小写的，但同步规则编辑器将对表达式求值并在表达式无效时提供警告。 所有表达式都使用嵌套函数表示在一行上。 为了显示配置语言的强大功能，下面给出了 pwdLastSet 流的示例，但插入了附加注释： 复制 // If-then-else IIF( // (The evaluation for IIF) Is the attribute pwdLastSet present in AD? IsPresent([pwdLastSet]), // (The True part of IIF) If it is, then from right to left, convert the AD time format to a .Net datetime, change it to the time format used by Azure AD, and finally convert it to a string. CStr(FormatDateTime(DateFromNum([pwdLastSet]),"yyyyMMddHHmmss.0Z")), // (The False part of IIF) Nothing to contribute NULL ) 有关属性流表达式语言的详细信息，请参阅了解声明性预配表达式。

searchText: Not Verfified的自定义域中的账户同步到Azure AD，是否可以使用本地密码登录 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure AD Section: KB 最近修改: 2022-02-23 13:03:35 JD 相关性: Azure AD 一句话摘要 问题： 问题现象 / 场景 问题： 背景信息 问题： 本地为sx@evazhang.xyz ，同步到azure后，会变为sx@abc.partner.onmschina.cn 用户在配置AAD Connect同步时，看到有以下提示，认为是不能使用本地密码登陆的。 提示有一定的误导，请大家知悉。 参考工单：SR 20211125134217 Enterprise AD同步Azure AD问题咨询 排查思路 如果在Azure AD中添加的自定义域名为未验证，本地同步到Azure上的账户的后缀会变为Azure AD域名的后缀。例如， 这种情况下，sx@abc.partner.onmschina.cn是否能够用本地的密码登陆Azure Portal。 但是，经搭建环境测试验证，是可以使用本地密码登录的，说明密码的哈希也是同步上来的。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2021/12/01 问题： 如果在Azure AD中添加的自定义域名为未验证，本地同步到Azure上的账户的后缀会变为Azure AD域名的后缀。例如， 本地为sx@evazhang.xyz ，同步到azure后，会变为sx@abc.partner.onmschina.cn 这种情况下，sx@abc.partner.onmschina.cn是否能够用本地的密码登陆Azure Portal。 用户在配置AAD Connect同步时，看到有以下提示，认为是不能使用本地密码登陆的。 但是，经搭建环境测试验证，是可以使用本地密码登录的，说明密码的哈希也是同步上来的。 提示有一定的误导，请大家知悉。 参考工单：SR 20211125134217 Enterprise AD同步Azure AD问题咨询

searchText: Share Azure存储账号的TLS配置和开放端口说明 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure AD Section: KB 最近修改: 2025-12-12 14:06:46 JD 相关性: Azure AD 一句话摘要 Update 问题现象 / 场景 Update 背景信息 Update Jia.Xiaolei Zhang.Wenxin 资源id：/subscriptions/83739bdb-a4a9-4863-9a15-f3cebeb4f264/resourceGroups/COMPLIANCE-CAR-CONNECT-PG-STG-RG/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/pgsastg1 1，TLS 版本这里，您已设置最小支持版本为TLS 1.2 Ports Descriptions 22 111, 2048 80, 443 2443, 8443, 8080, 2047 排查思路 Azure 存储当前支持 TLS 协议的三个版本：1.0、1.1 和 1.2. Azure 存储在公共 HTTPS 终结点上使用 TLS 1.2，但仍支持 TLS 1.0 和 TLS 1.1 以实现后向兼容性。从客户侧只能配置最小的TLS的版本。暂无法直接禁止低版本的TLS。当客户端使用不满足为帐户配置的最低 TLS 版本的 TLS 版本访问存储帐户时，Azure 存储会返回错误代码 400 错误（错误请求），并返回一条消息，指示不允许所使用的 TLS 版本对此存储帐户发出请求。也就是说，如果您当前的存储配置的最低TLS版本为1.2, 您通过安全软件扫描查看存储账号仍然有TLS 1.0/1.1. 您客户端发起低版本的TLS请求也是不会被存储接收的。 经与后线团队确认，这些为system access ports, 并不对外提供服务，没有公开说明 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 近日，接到客户反馈：需要确认渗透测试中检测出的存储账户监听的端口 参考工单：SR 20251119383212 需要确认渗透测试中检测出的存储账户监听的端口 2，针对检测到的放开端口： 针对存储账户放开的这些端口，从用户侧是无法禁用的。对于端口的用途、说明详见下方信息： 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 ICM: 官方文档说明: 官方文档说明: 官方文档说明: 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Update 2025/12/12 Jia.Xiaolei Zhang.Wenxin 近日，接到客户反馈：需要确认渗透测试中检测出的存储账户监听的端口 资源id：/subscriptions/83739bdb-a4a9-4863-9a15-f3cebeb4f264/resourceGroups/COMPLIANCE-CAR-CONNECT-PG-STG-RG/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/pgsastg1 参考工单：SR 20251119383212 需要确认渗透测试中检测出的存储账户监听的端口 ICM: 1，TLS 版本这里，您已设置最小支持版本为TLS 1.2 Azure 存储当前支持 TLS 协议的三个版本：1.0、1.1 和 1.2. source: VM/Azure AD/KB/2025-05-22_Windows server 2016 & 2019配置ADFS与AAD实现联合身份验证.md

1] extend Impactlevel = properties.impact extend Advise = properties.shortDescription.solution extend LastUpdatedDate = properties.lastUpdated extend ImpactedField = properties.impactedField project Impactlevel, Advise, subscriptionId, ImpactedField, resourceGroup, Resource, LastUpdatedDate 注：如果希望查看所有订阅的情况，可以把第二行（ where subscriptionId == "1447ccf1-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2f370d142fa6"）删除。 将查询结果以csv格式进行导出 以上查询结果导出的CSV

searchText: Azure Policy的一些注意点和坑 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Advisory Policy Section: KB 最近修改: 2021-02-25 17:40:27 JD 相关性: Defender/Sentinel/安全; Azure AD 一句话摘要 重新分配策略或计划的作用域到其他订阅时，提示“..指定的策略定义超出作用域..”，是由于您策略或计划的定义位置是当前订阅，因此，无法分配到其他订阅。 问题现象 / 场景 重新分配策略或计划的作用域到其他订阅时，提示“..指定的策略定义超出作用域..”，是由于您策略或计划的定义位置是当前订阅，因此，无法分配到其他订阅。 SR 2021021279943 [S500]unable to enforce the sql server with minimum tls version 1.2 with deployIfNotExist effect. 背景信息 会在 策略 – 分配 中显示。因此，安全中心默认策略不需要Policy再进行配置。 当部署了DeployIfNotExists 策略，也就是在条件满足时将执行模板部署的策略后，默认此分配对新创建的资源有效，也就是新创建资源满足条件时，就会执行模板部署。对现有资源会检测符合性，但不会执行部署，可以手动部署修正任务。 在进行DeployIfNotExists的策略时，通过会写一些existenceCondition的属性，请注意以下这个坑。 参考工单： SR 2021020779383 [S500]安全中心的内置Azure Policy 排查思路 1. 可以参考以下文档查看安全中心启用的安全策略。 门户查看安全策略截图参考： 通过安全中心 – 安全策略 – 选择具体订阅 - 查看有效策略 中显示的 安全中心默认策略 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 参考文档： 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2021-2-25 1. 可以参考以下文档查看安全中心启用的安全策略。 门户查看安全策略截图参考： 通过安全中心 – 安全策略 – 选择具体订阅 - 查看有效策略 中显示的 安全中心默认策略 会在 策略 – 分配 中显示。因此，安全中心默认策略不需要Policy再进行配置。 重新分配策略或计划的作用域到其他订阅时，提示“..指定的策略定义超出作用域..”，是由于您策略或计划的定义位置是当前订阅，因此，无法分配到其他订阅。 参考文档： 当部署了DeployIfNotExists 策略，也就是在条件满足时将执行模板部署的策略后，默认此分配对新创建的资源有效，也就是新创建资源满足条件时，就会执行模板部署。对现有资源会检测符合性，但不会执行部署，可以手动部署修正任务。 在进行DeployIfNotExists的策略时，通过会写一些existenceCondition的属性，请注意以下这个坑。 参考工单： SR 2021020779383 [S500]安全中心的内置Azure Policy SR 2021021279943 [S500]unable to enforce the sql server with minimum tls version 1.2 with deployIfNotExist effect.

searchText: 2023/07/19 Microsoft Entra 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Arc Section: Mooncake AAD features 最近修改: 2023-07-19 13:01:55 JD 相关性: Azure AD 一句话摘要 Azure AD Rebrand FAQ 问题现象 / 场景 Azure AD Rebrand FAQ 背景信息 Azure AD Rebrand FAQ Purpose Azure AD(Azure Active Directory) is being renamed to Microsoft Entra ID. Public announcement happened on July 11th 2023, during Reimagine Secure Access with Microsoft Entra digital event . This document is intended for internal use only, to help prepare support engineers to help with answers to frequently asked customer question about Azure AD Rebrand. General/ Customer Facing FAQs Link to public facing docs article is available. Support specific - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) This is a collection of frequently asked questions we expect customers might have, related to rebrand. What is Microsoft Entra? Microsoft Entra ID – generally available (Formerly known as Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)) Microsoft Entra ID Governance – GA July 1, 2023 Microsoft Entra Internet Access – Public Preview Microsoft Entra Private Access – Public Preview Microsoft Entra External ID – Public Preview Microsoft Entra Permissions Management – generally available Microsoft Entra Verified ID – generally available Microsoft Entra Workload ID - generally available Refer to Appendix 1 for more details on Microsoft Entra Product Family. What is Microsoft Entra ID? Use full product and feature names, do not abbreviate, or use acronyms. Attribute all features and components to the Microsoft Entra product family. Examples: Microsoft Entra Tenant Microsoft Entra Conditional Access Microsoft Entra Passwordless Microsoft Entra Roles Microsoft Entra Joined Hybrid Microsoft Entra Joined Microsoft Entra Registered For additional guidelines and detailed information about Microsoft Entra branding, please refer to the Microsoft Entra Branding Playbook . Why is Microsoft changing name of Azure AD? What is the need of rebrand? Why are we doing this? What was the need of new name? Unifying all identity and access capabilities under the Microsoft Entra name will make it easier to navigate and use the entire repertoire of products in our expanded portfolio and ensure that you have the strongest protections for any access point. When is the name change happening? Exact dates on product name change I am using in my env – e.g. ADDS Answer: Most products will change display names between August 15 till end of year 2023. By Mid- July, we will publish a plan and timeline for product name changes across IDNA products. Do I (support engineer) need to ask or tell my customer proactively about rebrand post July 11th? Answer: Please share details about rebranding only if customer asks about it. What does rebrand of Azure AD mean for customer? How will the change impact customers? Do they need to do anything? Answer: No action is required from customers. No changes to capabilities, licenses, pricing, service level agreements, APIs, URLs, Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), nor developer experiences. To ensure no service interruption, the following experiences of Azure AD will not change: URLs For example, APIs / endpoints – for example, the Microsoft Graph API Developer experiences – Microsoft Authentication Libraries, Microsoft Identity Platform (these do not carry the Azure AD name) The changes will not cause any functionality change or downtime. There are no changes to any existing deployments or integrations, they will continue to work without interruption. Product certifications continue to be valid after the product renaming. Customer Support (CSS) is aware of the changes and will be prepared to assist customers with any questions. During 2023, you may see both the current Azure AD name and new Microsoft Entra ID name in support area paths. For self-service support, look for the topic path of “Microsoft Entra” or “Azure Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID”. What is NOT being rebranded? Answer: These names and services aren’t changing: Microsoft identity platform – Build applications your users and customers can sign into using their Microsoft identities or social accounts. Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) – Acquire security tokens from the Microsoft identity platform to authenticate users and access secured web APIs to provide secure access to Microsoft Graph, other Microsoft APIs, third-party web APIs, or your own web API. Microsoft Graph – Get programmatic access to organizational, user, and application data stored in Azure AD. Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) nor Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) nor any feature names for Active Directory. Azure Active Directory B2C will continue to be available as an Azure service. Any deprecated or retired functionality, feature, or service of Azure Active Directory Is Azure AD going away entirely? Answer: No, only the name Azure AD is being rebranded to Microsoft Entra ID. Customers continue to have access to the same capabilities. Is my(Customer's) support plan/licensing changing? Will I(Customer) be charged more or less on my current plan? Answer: All features and capabilities are still available. Licensing, terms and pricing remain the same. To make the transition seamless, URLs, APIs, and authentication libraries stay the same, as do developer experiences. Will all existing access points to Azure Active Directory still work? Do I(customer) need to change my official documentation or references to Azure AD? Answer: Microsoft will continue to make string name changes over the second half of the year. What new/old products/services are part of Microsoft Entra ID? What products are not included in Microsoft Entra ID Answer: Microsoft Entra helps you protect all identities and secure network access everywhere. Refer to Appendix 1 for more details on Microsoft Entra Product Family. Is there any change in SLA or other customer commitments as part of rebrand? Answer: There is no change in our SLA commitment. Azure Active Directory SLA performance - Microsoft Entra Microsoft Learn Where can I go learn more about the rebrand Why does product A say Azure Active directory and product B says Microsoft Entra ID? Answer: Name changes will roll out in phased manner over second half of 2023. whether the underlying display names would be affected for scenarios using REST, PoSH and the SDK. Some Customers are using Display Names. Does it cause breaking change, if yes, we are not changing Answer: No Breaking changes are introduced as part of rebrand. Does this impact our Product Group names? Answer: Only display name for products will change. At this time, there is no change to Product Group Names. Will this break any existing links to our public documentation? Answer: No. There wont be any breaks in existing documentation link. Only display name in documents will change. Guidance for 3rd Party Developer Answer: Identity developer experiences are not impacted by the rename. Microsoft identity platform encompasses all our identity and access developer assets. Our name is not changing, and we’re committed to delivering resources for you to learn how to secure access for everyone and everything. Naming is also not changing for: Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) – Acquire security tokens from the Microsoft identity platform to authenticate users and access secured web APIs to provide secure access to Microsoft Graph, other Microsoft APIs, third-party web APIs, or your own web API. Microsoft Graph – Get programmatic access to organizational, user, and application data stored in Azure AD. Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) nor Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) nor the product name “Active Directory” or any corresponding features. Azure Active Directory B2C will continue to be available as an Azure service. Any deprecated or retired functionality, feature, or service of Azure Active Directory We are grateful for your continued partnership in building a safer world for all, and we’d like your help spreading the word about the name change and implementing it in your own experiences. We are providing complete naming guidance in Microsoft Learn and ask that you please update customer-facing content and experiences with the new name in 2023. Additional Resources Microsoft Entra Security Hub page has additional internal and customer resources Technical documentation and resources available on MS Learn: Microsoft Entra Azure AD rebrand information and guidance APPENDIX Appendix Table 1 - Entra Product Family Identity & access management New identity categories Network access Microsoft Entra ID (Formerly known as Azure AD) Microsoft Entra Verified ID Microsoft Entra Internet Access Microsoft Entra ID Governance Microsoft Entra Permissions Management Microsoft Entra Private Access Microsoft Entra External ID Microsoft Entra Workload ID Formerly.. Is Now.. Azure AD Free Microsoft Entra ID Free Azure AD Premium P1 Microsoft Entra ID P1 Azure AD Premium P2 Microsoft Entra ID P2 Azure AD External Identities 排查思路 This change requires No Customer Action as this is rename of Azure AD(Azure Active Directory) to Microsoft Entra ID. Customers who are using Azure AD today or are currently deploying it in their organizations can continue to use the service without interruption. All existing deployments, configurations, and integrations will continue to function as they do today. All features and capabilities are still available. Licensing, terms, and pricing remain the same. To make the transition seamless, all existing login URLs, APIs, and Microsoft authentication libraries (MSAL) stay the same, as do developer experiences and tooling. Starting July 11th 2023, customers will see notifications in Administrator portal, on websites, in documentation, and other places where they may interact with Azure AD. We’ll continue to update the name change in our products from Azure AD to Microsoft Entra ID, starting August 15, 2023 till end of calendar year 2023. Always keep “Microsoft” and Entra locked together. Do not drop the Microsoft brand name. Example Microsoft Entra ID Do I go to Azure portal or Entra portal ? Answer: Yes - existing Azure Active Directory functionality can be accessed via the Microsoft Entra admin center, M365 admin center and Azure Portal. All existing links will continue to function the same. Does this mean Discontinuation of Azure AD on Azure portal? Is Azure AD or any other product, going to be deprecated from Azure portal? July 11th Announcement Blog post 操作步骤 / 命令 Microsoft Graph PowerShell – Acts as an API wrapper for the Microsoft Graph APIs; helps administer every Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) feature that has an API in Microsoft Graph. Are Urls or powershell paths changing? Answer: This is only display name change. There will be No Breaking Changes with the rebrand. All URLs and powershell paths going to remain same. Microsoft Graph PowerShell – Acts as an API wrapper for the Microsoft Graph APIs; helps administer every Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) feature that has an API in Microsoft Graph. 关键参数 / 状态码 Answer: Microsoft Entra ID is new name for Azure Active Directory or Azure AD. Microsoft Entra ID provides a complete identity and access management solution with integrated security to manage and protect all users and data. Customers can safeguard their organization with a leading cloud identity and access management solution that connects employees, customers and partners to their apps, devices, and data. Refer to Appendix 2 for more information on SKU names How should I refer to Microsoft Entra products and features? Answer: The name change will start appearing across Microsoft experiences after 30 days from announcement(on July 11th, 2023). We’ll continue to update the name change in our products from Azure AD to Microsoft Entra ID, starting August 15th, 2023 till end of calendar year 2023. Display names for SKUs and Service Plans will change on September 1, 2023. Are the existing Azure AD SKU changing? Answer: Yes, e

source: VM/Azure Databox.one/Azure Databox/2022-04-15_Assisting customers with Data Box POD order status inquiries.md
searchText: Assisting customers with Data Box POD order status inquiries 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-04-15 07:00:31 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 Common Data Box POD Order Creation Issues 问题现象 / 场景 Common Data Box POD Order Creation Issues Some of the most commonly asked issues regarding the status of a Data Box POD job include the following: 背景信息 Microsoft Stream Data Box Model not Available The Data Box service does not currently support all customer countries and regions. The service also supports data ingestion or egress only within the same country/region as the destination, and won't cross any international borders. The only exception is for orders in the European Union (EU), where Data Boxes can ship to and from any EU country/region. For information regarding region availability for the Azure Data Box service, go to: Azure Products by Region For detailed and updated information, go to: Order Data Box Could not Create Data Box Order In order to create a Data Box order, the following is required: A Microsoft Azure storage account with access credentials, such as the storage account name and access key. An Azure subscription of one of the following types: Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA) for new subscriptions or Microsoft Enterprise Agreement (EA) for existing subscriptions. Read more about MCA for new subscriptions and EA subscriptions. Microsoft Azure Sponsorship Microsoft Partner Network (MPN) Owner or contributor access to the Azure subscription For detailed and updated information, go to: Prerequisites for service Could not Create Additional Data Box Orders The Data Box service limits each Azure subscription to 5 active Data Box orders. For detailed and updated information, go to: Data Box subscription limits When will I receive the Data Box? 排查思路 Could not Validate Address The Data Box service uses the UPS Address Validator to validate customer addresses. Ensure the address is formatted correctly, then use the Validator to confirm that the address is valid. If the address is valid, but the issue still occurs when creating the Data Box order, raise an IcM with the Data Box SaaS team for assistance. Use Lens or ASC to check the status of a Data Box job. Tracking information can be found and relayed to the customer once the device has been shipped. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 Cloud Solution Provider (CSP). Learn more about Azure CSP program (This service is not supported for the Azure CSP program in India). 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Microsoft Stream Common Data Box POD Order Creation Issues Some of the most commonly asked issues regarding the status of a Data Box POD job include the following: Data Box Model not Available The Data Box service does not currently support all customer countries and regions. The service also supports data ingestion or egress only within the same country/region as the destination, and won't cross any international borders. The only exception is for orders in the European Union (EU), where Data Boxes can ship to and from any EU country/region. For information regarding region availability for the Azure Data Box service, go to: Azure Products by Region For detailed and updated information, go to: Order Data Box Could not Validate Address The Data Box service uses the UPS Address Validator to validate customer addresses. Ensure the address is formatted correctly, then use the Validator to confirm that the address is valid. If the address is valid, but the issue still occurs when creating the Data Box order, raise an IcM with the Data Box SaaS team for assistance. source: VM/Azure Databox.one/Azure Databox/2022-04-20_Importing managed disks using Data Box POD.md
searchText: Importing managed disks using Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-04-20 06:55:00 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. The VHDs from on-premises VMs are copied to Data Box as page blobs and are uploaded into Azure as managed disks. These managed disks can then b... 问题现象 / 场景 You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. The VHDs from on-premises VMs are copied to Data Box as page blobs and are uploaded into Azure as managed disks. These managed disks can then be attached to Azure VMs. 背景信息 You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. The VHDs from on-premises VMs are copied to Data Box as page blobs and are uploaded into Azure as managed disks. These managed disks can then be attached to Azure VMs. Based on the resource groups specified, Data Box creates one share for each associated resource group. For example, if mydbmdrg1 and mydbmdrg2 were created when placing the order, the following shares are created: mydbmdrg1 MDisk mydbmdrg2 Mdisk Within each share, the following three folders are created which correspond to containers in your storage account. Premium SSD Standard HDD Standard SSD The following table shows the UNC paths to the shares on your Data Box. UNC path to the share SMB \\<DeviceIPAddress \<ResourceGroupName MDisk \<PremiumSSD \file1.vhd \\<DeviceIPAddress \<ResourceGroupName MDisk \<StandardHDD \file2.vhd \\<DeviceIPAddress \<ResourceGroupName MDisk \<StandardSSD \file3.vhd NFS //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroup1 MDisk /<PremiumSSD /file1.vhd //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /<StandardHDD /file2.vhd //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /<StandardSSD /file3.vhd You will need to use either SMB or NFS to connect to the Data Box shares and upload VHDs. Connecting via REST APIs is not supported for the managed disk import feature of Data Box. Review the following considerations before you begin data copy: Always copy the VHDs to one of the precreated folders. If you copy the VHDs outside of these folders or in a folder that you created, the VHDs will be uploaded to Azure Storage account as page blobs and not managed disks. You can only have one managed disk with a given name in a resource group across all of the precreated folders. This implies that the VHDs uploaded to the precreated folders should have unique names. Make sure that the given name does not match an already existing managed disk in a resource group. Review managed disk limits in Azure object size limits. For more information on importing VHD files to managed disks using Data Box, please see the link below. Use Data Box to import data as managed disks in Azure 排查思路 If there are errors during the copy process, download the logs from the Connect and copy page. If you copied a file that is not 512 bytes aligned, the file isn't uploaded as page blob to your staging storage account. You will see an error in the logs. Remove the file and copy a file that is 512 bytes aligned. If you copied a VHDX (these files are not supported) with a long name, you will see errors in the logs similar to those shown below. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 Connection protocol 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 Only fixed size VHDs can be uploaded to create managed disks. VHDX files or dynamic and differencing VHDs are not supported. 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. title: Ordering a Data Box POD
summary: To create a Data Box order, customers must have an A
source: VM/Azure Databox.one/Azure Databox/2022-04-06_Ordering a Data Box POD.md
searchText: Ordering a Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-04-06 07:08:25 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 To create a Data Box order, customers must have an Azure subscription of the type MCA (Microsoft Customer Agreement), EA (Enterprise Agreement), CSP (Cloud Solution Provider), MPN (Microsoft Partner Network), or Microsoft Azure Sponsorship. 问题现象 / 场景 To create a Data Box order, customers must have an Azure subscription of the type MCA (Microsoft Customer Agreement), EA (Enterprise Agreement), CSP (Cloud Solution Provider), MPN (Microsoft Partner Network), or Microsoft Azure Sponsorship. 背景信息 Order Azure Data Box for Import Order Azure Data Box for Export Microsoft Stream 排查思路 In most cases the customer will want to create a Data Box order through the Azure portal. To do this, they will sign into the Azure portal, select "Create a resource", search for "Azure Data Box", and then click "Create". The customer can then select either the "Import to Azure" or "Export from Azure" transfer type, choose the type of device to order (Data Box device, Data Box Heavy, or Data Box Disk), and set other options such as Azure subscription, resource group, and the storage account(s) to import data to or export data from. The customer can either choose to use the default security settings for Data Box, or they can choose to set up their own encryption keys and passwords. After the customer enters their shipping address and submits the order, they will be able to track the order status through the Azure portal. If they need to cancel an order, they can do so as long as the order has not yet reached the "Processed" status. Further information on ordering Data Box devices through the Azure portal can be found at the links below. 操作步骤 / 命令 It is also possible to order Data Box devices and track order status using the Azure CLI or Azure PowerShell. Some customers who have a need to create large numbers of Data Box orders may choose to use one of these methods so that they can manage the ordering process using scripts instead of the Azure portal UI. searchText: Requirements and limits 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-11-08 11:32:53 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 Although copying via both SMB and NFS in parallel can work, we don't recommend doing that as it's prone to human error. Wait until your SMB data copy is complete before you start an NFS data copy. 问题现象 / 场景 Although copying via both SMB and NFS in parallel can work, we don't recommend doing that as it's prone to human error. Wait until your SMB data copy is complete before you start an NFS data copy. If the CreateTime or LastWriteTime field for a file exceeds the allowable size during an upload, “Fri, 31 Dec 9999 23:59:59” replaces the original date in the Azure file property. The file upload succeeds, and no error is raised. Cannot end with the forward slash (/). The number of path segments comprising the blob name cannot exceed 254. A path segment is the string between consecutive delimiter characters (for example, the forward slash '/') that correspond to the name of a virtual directory. 背景信息 Microsoft Stream Azure Data Box system requirements Supported operating systems for clients Here is a list of the supported operating systems for the data copy operation via the clients connected to your device. Operating system Versions Notes Windows Server 2016 RS1 and later 2019 RS5 and later With earlier editions of these operating systems, you can't use RoboCopy in Backup mode (robocopy /B) to copy files that contain Alternate Data Streams (ADS) or use Extended Attributes (EAs) in their Access Control Lists (ACLs). Windows 7, 8, 10 Linux SMB 3.0 and 2.0 NFS All versions up to and including 4.1 For NFS shares, copying data into Data Box from an Advanced Interactive Executive (AIX) host using the IBM Database 2 (DB2) Export tool is not supported. Supported storage accounts for imports For import orders, following table shows the supported storage accounts. Storage account / Supported storage types Block blob Page blob1 Azure files Supported access tiers Classic Standard Y General-purpose v1 Standard Hot, Cool General-purpose v1 Premium General-purpose v2 Standard2 General-purpose v2 Premium Azure Premium FileStorage Blob storage Standard 1 Data uploaded to page blobs must be 512 bytes aligned such as VHDs. 2 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2) is supported for imports but not for exports. Supported storage accounts for exports For export orders, following table shows the supported storage accounts. Page blob General-purpose v2 Standard Block Blob storage Premium Page Blob storage Premium Caveats for storage accounts For General-purpose accounts: For import orders, Data Box does not support Queue, Table, and Disk storage types. For export orders, Data Box does not support Queue, Table, Disk, and Azure Data Lake Gen2 storage types. Data Box does not support append blobs for Blob Storage and Block Blob Storage accounts. Data uploaded to page blobs must be 512 bytes aligned such as VHDs. For exports: A maximum of 80 TB can be exported. File history and blob snapshots are not exported. Archive blobs are not supported for export. Rehydrate the blobs in archive tier before you export. For more information, see Rehydrate an archived blob to an online tier. Supported storage types Here is a list of the supported storage types for the Data Box device. File format Azure block blob Azure page blob The data should be 512 bytes aligned. Azure Files Supported web browsers Here is a list of web browsers supported for the local web UI. Browser Additional requirements/notes Google Chrome Latest version Tested with Chrome Microsoft Edge FireFox Tested with FireFox Internet Explorer Networking requirements Your datacenter needs to have high-speed network. We strongly recommend you have at least one 10-GbE connection. If a 10-GbE connection isn't available, you can use a 1-GbE data link to copy data, but the copy speeds are affected. Port requirements Port no. In or out Port scope Required TCP 80 (HTTP) In LAN Yes This port is used to connect to Data Box Blob storage REST APIs over HTTP. If not connecting to REST APIs, this automatically redirects to local web UI over 8443. TCP 443 (HTTPS) This port is used to connect to Data Box Blob storage REST APIs over HTTPS. If not connecting to REST APIs, this automatically redirects to local web UI over 8443. TCP 8443 (HTTPS-Alt) This is an alternative port for HTTPS and is used when connecting to local web UI for device management. TCP 445 (SMB) Out/In In some cases See notes This port is required only if you're connecting via SMB. TCP 2049 (NFS) This port is required only if you're connecting via NFS. TCP 111 (NFS) This port is used for rpcbind/port mapping and required only if you're connecting via NFS. Data Box limits Data Box can store a maximum of 500 million files for both import and export. Data Box supports a maximum of 512 containers or shares in the cloud. The top-level directories within the user share become containers or Azure file shares in the cloud. Data Box usage capacity may be less than 80 TiB because of ReFS metadata space consumption. Data Box supports a maximum of 10 client connections at a time on an NFS share. Data copy and upload caveats For import order Data Box caveats for an import order include: Containers, shares, and folders: Don't copy files directly to any of the precreated shares. You need to create a folder under the share and then copy files to that folder. A folder under the StorageAccount BlockBlob and StorageAccount PageBlob is a container. For instance, containers are created as StorageAccount BlockBlob/container and StorageAccount PageBlob/container. Each folder created directly under StorageAccount AzFile is translated into an Azure File Share. Azure Blob Storage doesn't support directories. If you create a folder under the StorageAccount BlockBlob folder, then virtual folders are created in the blob name. For Azure Files, the actual directory structure is maintained. Merging folder contents: Every file written into StorageAccount BlockBlob and StorageAccount PageBlob shares is uploaded as a block blob and page blob respectively. If a folder has the same name as an existing container, the folder's contents are merged with the container's contents. Files or blobs that aren't already in the cloud are added to the container. If a file or blob has the same name as a file or blob that's already in the container, the existing file or blob is overwritten. An upload to a blob in the Archive tier will fail if the container has an existing archived blob with the same name. While a blob is in the Archive tier, it can't be read or modified. If you need to overwrite a blob, make sure the blob isn't set to archive. For more information, see Archive access tier. Any empty directory hierarchy (without any files) created under StorageAccount BlockBlob and StorageAccount PageBlob folders isn't uploaded. Use different storage accounts for SMB and NFS. Don't copy the same data to the same end destination in Azure using both SMB and NFS. In these cases, the final outcome can't be determined. Upload management: File metadata and NTFS permissions can be preserved when the data is uploaded to Azure Files using guidance in Preserving file ACLs, attributes, and timestamps with Azure Data Box. The hierarchy of the files is maintained while uploading to the cloud for both blobs and Azure Files. For example, you copied a file at this path: <container folder \A\B\C.txt. This file is uploaded to the same path in cloud. For export order Data Box caveats for an export order include: Data Box is a Windows-based device and doesn’t support case-sensitive file names. For example, you may have two different files in Azure with names that just differ in casing. Don't use Data Box to export such files as the files will be overwritten on the device. Data Box exports data to Windows-based system over SMB and is limited by SMB limitations for files and folders. Files and folders with unsupported names aren't exported. There is a 1:1 mapping from prefix to container. Maximum filename size is 1024 characters. Filenames that exceed this length aren't exported. Duplicate prefixes in the xml file (uploaded during order creation) are exported. Duplicate prefixes are not ignored. Page blobs and container names are case-sensitive. If the casing is mismatched, the blob and/or container will not be found. Azure storage account size limits Here are the limits on the size of the data that's copied into a storage account. Make sure the data you upload conforms to these limits. For the most up-to-date information on these limits, see Scalability and performance targets for Blob storage and Azure Files scalability and performance targets. Size of data copied into Azure storage account Default limit Block blob and page blob Maximum limit is the same as the Storage limit defined for Azure Subscription and it includes data from all the sources including Data Box. Data Box supports Azure Premium File Shares, which allow a total of 100 TiB for all shares in the storage account. All folders under StorageAccount AzFile must follow this limit. For more information, see Create an Azure file share. Azure object size limits Here are the sizes of the Azure objects that can be written. Make sure that all the files that are uploaded conform to these limits. Azure object type ~ 4.75 TiB Page blob 4 TiB Every file uploaded in page blob format must be 512 bytes aligned (an integral multiple), else the upload fails. VHD and VHDX are 512 bytes aligned. 1 TiB Managed disks For more information on size and limits, see: Scalability targets of Standard SSDs Scalability targets of Premium SSDs Scalability targets of Standard HDDs Pricing and billing of managed disks Azure block blob, page blob, and file naming conventions Entity Conventions Container names for block blob and page blob Must be a valid DNS name that is 3 to 63 characters long. Must start with a letter or number. Every hyphen (-) must be immediately preceded and followed by a letter or number. Consecutive hyphens aren't permitted in names. Share names for Azure files Same as above Directory and file names for Azure files Case-preserving, case-insensitive and must not exceed 255 characters in length. If provided, it will be automatically removed. Following characters aren't allowed: " \ / : < ? Reserved URL characters must be properly escaped. Following file names aren't allowed: LPT1, LPT2, LPT3, LPT4, LPT5, LPT6, LPT7, LPT8, LPT9, COM1, COM2, COM3, COM4, COM5, COM6, COM7, COM8, COM9, PRN, AUX, NUL, CON, CLOCK$, dot character (.), and two dot characters (..). Blob names for block blob and page blob Blob names are case-sensitive and can contain any combination of characters. A blob name must be between 1 to 1,024 characters long. For more information, please visit the links below: Azure Data Box System Requirements Azure Data Box Blob Storage Requirements Azure Data Box Limits 排查思路 The following table lists the ports that need to be opened in your firewall to allow for SMB or NFS traffic. In this table, In (inbound) refers to the direction from which incoming client requests access to your device. Out (or outbound) refers to the direction in which your Data Box device sends data externally, beyond the deployment. For example, data might be outbound to the Internet. If there are any errors when uploading data to Azure, an error log is created in the target storage account. The path to this error log is available when the upload is complete, and you can review the log to take corrective action. Don't delete data from the source without verifying the uploaded data. If you have duplicate tags in input files or tags referring to the same data, the Data Box export might skip or overwrite the files. The number of files and size of data that the Azure portal displays might differ from the actual size of data on the device. searchText: Running Prepare to Ship and returning the Data Box 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-04-20 07:18:00 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with Azure storage requirements and limits. 问题现象 / 场景 This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with Azure storage requirements and limits. After the Prepare to Ship process completes without errors, the customer can proceed with shipping the Data Box back to the Azure datacenter for data import. The steps for return shipping of a Data Box device vary by country. More information on return shipping can be found at this link: Ship Data Box back. 背景信息 To start Prepare to Ship, in the device web UI, go to Prepare to Ship and click on "Start Preparation". During the Prepare to Ship process, the Data Box shares will be taken offline and will not be accessible. Please ensure that all data to be imported is copied onto the shares prior to running Prepare to Ship. If there is more data that needs to be copied to the device, you can stop Prepare to Ship, unlock the device, copy the additional data, and then run Prepare to Ship again. The length of time required for Prepare to Ship to run depends on the amount of data the customer has written to the Data Box and the number of individual files and blobs. Prepare to Ship may take anywhere from a few hours for smaller data sets to several days for data sets containing many millions of files and/or blobs. Microsoft Stream 排查思路 When using Data Box to import data into Azure, before return shipping the device back to the Azure datacenter, the customer must run the Prepare to Ship process. This process validates the data by: Ensuring that checksums are generated for all files Checking that all data conforms to Azure naming conventions Checking that files and blobs are not too large for Azure storage file / blob size limits Checking that all container and share names conform to Azure naming conventions For more information on Prepare to Ship and the return shipping process, please see this link: Return Azure Data Box and verify data upload to Azure. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 If Prepare to Ship completes with the status "Scan completed with errors", the customer should resolve these errors before returning the device. To see what errors have occurred, unlock the device and go to the Connect and Copy page to download the issues list. Information on how to correct issues identified by Prepare to Ship can be found in the Troubleshooting Prepare to Ship page of this OneNote. After correcting these issues, the customer will need to run Prepare to Ship again to validate that all errors have been resolved. 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） When using Data Box to import data into Azure, before return shipping the device back to the Azure datacenter, the customer must run the Prepare to Ship process. This process validates the data by: Ensuring that checksums are generated for all files Checking that all data conforms to Azure naming conventions Checking that files and blobs are not too large for Azure storage file / blob size limits Checking that all container and share names conform to Azure naming conventions This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with Azure storage requirements and limits. To start Prepare to Ship, in the device web UI, go to Prepare to Ship and click on "Start Preparation". During the Prepare to Ship process, the Data Box shares will be taken offline and will not be accessible. Please ensure that all data to be imported is copied onto the shares prior to running Prepare to Ship. If there is more data that needs to be copied to the device, you can stop Prepare to Ship, unlock the device, copy the additional data, and then run Prepare to Ship again. The length of time required for Prepare to Ship to run depends on the amount of data the customer has written to the Data Box and the number of individual files and blobs. Prepare to Ship may take anywhere from a few hours for smaller data sets to several days for data sets containing many millions of files and/or blobs. If Prepare to Ship completes with the status "Scan completed with errors", the customer should resolve these errors before returning the device. To see what errors have occurred, unlock the device and go to the Connect and Copy page to download the issues list. Information on how to correct issues identified by Prepare to Ship can be found in the Troubleshooting Prepare to Ship page of this OneNote. After correcting these issues, the customer will need to run Prepare to Ship again to validate that all errors have been resolved. After the Prepare to Ship process completes without errors, the customer can proceed with shipping the Data Box back to the Azure datacenter for data import. The steps for return shipping of a Data Box device vary by country. More information on return shipping can be found at this link: Ship Data Box back. For more information on Prepare to Ship and the return shipping process, please see this link: Return Azure Data Box and verify data upload to Azure. Microsoft Stream

title: Use cases for Data Box POD

searchText: Use cases for Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-04-01 05:45:51 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 Use cases 问题现象 / 场景 Use cases 背景信息 Use cases Data Box is ideally suited to transfer data sizes larger than 40 TBs in scenarios with no to limited network connectivity. The data movement can be one-time, periodic, or an initial bulk data transfer followed by periodic transfers. Here are the various scenarios where Data Box can be used to import data to Azure. Onetime migration - when a large amount of on-premises data is moved to Azure. Moving a media library from offline tapes into Azure to create an online media library. Migrating your VM farm, SQL server, and applications to Azure. Moving historical data to Azure for in-depth analysis and reporting using HDInsight. Initial bulk transfer - when an initial bulk transfer is done using Data Box (seed) followed by incremental transfers over the network. Periodic uploads - when large amount of data is generated periodically and needs to be moved to Azure. For example in energy exploration, where video content is generated on oil rigs and windmill farms. Here are the various scenarios where Data Box can be used to export data from Azure. Disaster recovery - when a copy of the data from Azure is restored to an on-premises network. In a typical disaster recovery scenario, a large amount of Azure data is exported to a Data Box. Microsoft then ships this Data Box, and the data is restored on your premises in a short time. Security requirements - when you need to be able to export data out of Azure due to government or security requirements. For example, Azure Storage is available in US Secret and Top Secret clouds, and you can use Data Box to export data out of Azure. Migrate back to on-premises or to another cloud service provider - when you want to move all the data back to on-premises, or to another cloud service provider, export data via Data Box to migrate the workloads. searchText: Using the Data Copy Service 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Databox.one Section: Azure Databox 最近修改: 2022-04-20 06:45:41 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施 一句话摘要 Failed 问题现象 / 场景 Failed Completed with errors You can run up to 10 data copy service jobs concurrently to copy data from different SMB shares onto the Data Box. You can create unlimited numbers of jobs, but only 10 can be running at once. After all copy jobs is finished, you can select Prepare to Ship. The Prepare to Ship process cannot be run while a data copy service job is still in progress. 背景信息 The data copy service is a service that can be configured in the Data Box device web UI to bring data from network shares onto the Data Box for import into Azure storage. This service runs locally on Microsoft Azure Data Box, connects to a network-attached storage (NAS) device or network share via SMB, and copies data onto the Data Box. It is best to use the data copy service in the following circumstances: In NAS environments where intermediate hosts might not be available. With small files that take weeks for ingestion and upload of data. The data copy service significantly improves the ingestion and upload time for small files. To copy data by using the data copy service, you need to create a job using the following steps: In the local web UI of your Data Box device, go to Manage Copy data. On the Copy data page, select Create. Field Value Job name A unique name fewer than 230 characters for the job. These characters aren't allowed in the job name: <, , , ?, , \, :, /, and \. Source location Provide the SMB path to the data source in the format: \\<ServerIPAddress \<ShareName or \\<ServerName \<ShareName . Username Username in \\<DomainName <UserName format to access the data source. If a local administrator is connecting, they will need explicit security permissions. Right-click the folder, select Properties and then select Security. This should add the local administrator in the Security tab. Password Password to access the data source. Destination storage account Destination type Destination container/share Enter the name of the container or share that you want to upload data to in your destination storage account. The name can be a share name or a container name. For example, use myshare or mycontainer. You can also enter the name in the format sharename\directory name or containername\virtual directory name. Copy files matching pattern You can enter the file-name matching pattern in the following two ways: Use wildcard expressions: Only and ? are supported in wildcard expressions. For example, the expression .vhd matches all the files that have the .vhd extension. Similarly, .dl? matches all the files with either the extension .dl or that start with .dl, such as .dll. Likewise, foo matches all the files whose names end with foo. You can directly enter the wildcard expression in the field. By default, the value you enter in the field is treated as a wildcard expression. Use regular expressions: POSIX-based regular expressions are supported. For example, the regular expression . \.vhd will match all the files that have the .vhd extension. For regular expressions, provide the <pattern directly as regex(<pattern ). For more information about regular expressions, go to Regular expression language - a quick reference. File optimization If you use file optimization: After you run prepare to ship, you can download a BOM file, which lists the original file names, to help you ensure that all the right files are copied. Don't delete the packed files, whose file names begin with "ADB PACK ". If you delete a packed file, the original file isn't uploaded during future data copies. File optimization is not supported for Azure Files. To see what timestamps, file attributes, and ACLs are copied for a non-optimized data copy job, view the transferred metadata. You can pause a job if it's affecting the NAS device's resources during peak hours: You can resume the job later during off-peak hours: You can cancel a job at any time: When you cancel a job, a confirmation is required: If you decide to cancel a job, the data that is already copied isn't deleted. The simplest method to delete any data that you've copied to your Data Box device is to reset the device. While the job is in progress, on the Copy data page in the Status column, you can view the status of the copy job. The status can be: Running Succeeded Pausing Paused Canceling Canceled For more information on the data copy service, please see the link below. Use the data copy service to copy data into Azure Data Box (preview) 排查思路 In the Configure job and start dialog box, fill out the following fields: A job with the specified settings is created. In the Job details column, select View to see the job details. If any errors occur during the copy process, as shown in the Errors column, go to the Error log column and download the error logs for troubleshooting. 操作步骤 / 命令 Select the target storage account to upload data to from the list. The copy will complete in one of two ways: Data Copy to Azure at the Datacenter (For Support) Lens is an extremely useful tool that can be used to view details on an Azure Data Box job, such as device details, job and copy status, as well as information on tracking and relevant IcMs. Causes for Data Copy to Azure Slow or Stalled Copy If no IcMs exist for the Data Box job in question, raise an IcM with the XTDataPathTeam for assistance. 排查思路 Order status Completed — All of the data was ingested successfully, and the data copy percentage is 100%. The copy logs will be available for the customer to review and cross-verify their data in a separate container of the storage account the Data Box job was associated with. Order status Completed with errors — Some amount of data was not copied to Azure (could be 1% or 99%; 1 file, or multiple files). In most cases, when data fails to copy to Azure, the customer is not charged. Especially when the failure is the fault of Microsoft (i.e., hardware or software issue on our end). Customers can be charged if the failure of the copy is identified to be the fault of the customer in some way. The copy logs, including the verbose and error logs will be available for the customer to review and cross-verify their data in a separate container of the storage account the Data Box job was associated with. Lens and ASC For detailed and updated information, go to: Data Box Lens Dashboard (Note: These operations can also be done in ASC) When errors occur during the data copy to Azure, customers can review the copy logs to see how and why the data failed to copy. The copy logs also provide a summary of the job. For detailed and updated information, go to: Troubleshoot data copy issues If a customer notices that the data copy to Azure has slowed or stalled completely, verify using Lens or ASC. Once verified, do the following: Check Lens or ASC for any relevant IcMs that might have been opened automatically. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 Errors that occur during a copy job to Azure are generally caused by the customer ignoring errors and warnings shown during Prepare to Ship, or skipping Prepare to Ship entirely. 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Microsoft Stream Data Copy to Azure at the Datacenter Once the Data Box POD device has been received at the datacenter, it will be connected and the copy to Azure will begin. source: VM/Azure Microsoft Sentinel/Azure VD/2022-08-05_测试Azure Active Directory 加入的AVD主机池.md
searchText: 测试Azure Active Directory 加入的AVD主机池 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Microsoft Sentinel Section: Azure VD 最近修改: 2022-08-05 17:20:21 JD 相关性: Defender/Sentinel/安全 一句话摘要 这个功能之前测试会出现主机池主机不可用的状态，目前已经正常： 问题现象 / 场景 这个功能之前测试会出现主机池主机不可用的状态，目前已经正常： 背景信息 一、为用户分配对主机池的VM 配置角色分配 二、默认需要使用 Windows 桌面客户端连接，本地环境需满足： 本地电脑 Azure AD 会话主机联接到同一个 Azure AD 租户 本地电脑 Azure AD 与会话主机混合联接到同一个 Azure AD 租户 本地电脑在 Windows 10（2004 及更高版本）上运行，Azure AD 注册到与会话主机相同的 Azure AD 租户 排查思路 目前中国区的portal界面中已经可以使用加入Azure Active Directory 功能，而不需要部署ADDS，或这使用AADDS了。 设置好后需要如下2个额外步骤： 分配Virtual Machine User Login 角色让他们可以登录到 VM. 为需要本地管理权限的管理员分配Virtual Machine Administrator Login 角色. 操作步骤 / 命令 如果仍有以上问题，可以通过虚拟机的运行命令添加如下注册表项，重启虚拟机。 New-Item -Path HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\RDInfraAgent\AADJPrivate 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 若要从未联接至 Azure AD 的 Windows 设备或其他客户端连接进行访问，请将 targetisaadjoined:i:1 作为自定义 RDP 属性添加到主机池中。（该属性修改可能需要等待几分钟生效。） 参考链接 参考文档将主机池中主机加入AAD： 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2021-10-19 目前中国区的portal界面中已经可以使用加入Azure Active Directory 功能，而不需要部署ADDS，或这使用AADDS了。 参考文档将主机池中主机加入AAD： 设置好后需要如下2个额外步骤： 一、为用户分配对主机池的VM 配置角色分配 分配Virtual Machine User Login 角色让他们可以登录到 VM. 为需要本地管理权限的管理员分配Virtual Machine Administrator Login 角色. 二、默认需要使用 Windows 桌面客户端连接，本地环境需满足： 本地电脑 Azure AD 会话主机联接到同一个 Azure AD 租户 本地电脑 Azure AD 与会话主机混合联接到同一个 Azure AD 租户 本地电脑在 Windows 10（2004 及更高版本）上运行，Azure AD 注册到与会话主机相同的 Azure AD 租户 若要从未联接至 Azure AD 的 Windows 设备或其他客户端连接进行访问，请将 targetisaadjoined:i:1 作为自定义 RDP 属性添加到主机池中。（该属性修改可能需要等待几分钟生效。） 这个功能之前测试会出现主机池主机不可用的状态，目前已经正常： 如果仍有以上问题，可以通过虚拟机的运行命令添加如下注册表项，重启虚拟机。 New-Item -Path HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\RDInfraAgent\AADJPrivate

searchText: 自定义镜像无法加入AVD主机池的问题 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Microsoft Sentinel Section: Azure VD 最近修改: 2021-10-13 09:18:41 JD 相关性: Defender/Sentinel/安全 一句话摘要 跟进的一个工单问题：客户使用自己制作的镜像无法加入主机池的问题。 问题现象 / 场景 跟进的一个工单问题：客户使用自己制作的镜像无法加入主机池的问题。 现象：将已经加入主机池的虚拟机直接进行通用化捕获镜像，然后在新添加一个主机池的时候选择这个镜像，创建的新虚拟机默认无法加入主机池中。 背景信息 原因：和正常普通镜像相比，已经加入过主机池的虚拟机默认会安装一些软件，可能会存在冲突。 解决：尝试将已经加入主机池的虚拟机卸载下图这些软件以及退域操作，然后对其进行通用化捕获镜像，这样使用新的镜像创建的虚拟机默认就会在主机池里了。 排查思路 未从原文中明确识别。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2021-10-13 跟进的一个工单问题：客户使用自己制作的镜像无法加入主机池的问题。 现象：将已经加入主机池的虚拟机直接进行通用化捕获镜像，然后在新添加一个主机池的时候选择这个镜像，创建的新虚拟机默认无法加入主机池中。 原因：和正常普通镜像相比，已经加入过主机池的虚拟机默认会安装一些软件，可能会存在冲突。 解决：尝试将已经加入主机池的虚拟机卸载下图这些软件以及退域操作，然后对其进行通用化捕获镜像，这样使用新的镜像创建的虚拟机默认就会在主机池里了。

searchText: FSlogix磁盘压缩 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Microsoft Sentinel Section: Azure VD 最近修改: 2023-02-16 11:48:47 JD 相关性: Defender/Sentinel/安全 一句话摘要 日志集中有大量的以下报错，从报错来看，无法获取文件的size。 问题现象 / 场景 日志集中有大量的以下报错，从报错来看，无法获取文件的size。 背景信息 删除文件， 并注销账号ww后，profile文件自动压缩。 从日志中可以看到相应的压缩记录，附件是我测试环境的详细日志信息。 此问题应该是系统WMI的问题。 排查思路 搭建环境测试FSlogix磁盘压缩的功能是正常的。 测试账户ww登录后，复制一个大文件后，查看fslogix对应的文件共享中，profile的size变大。 排查： 查看客户提供的日志，发现日志中disk size reduced 都是0MB。 从目前的排查情况来看，主机池里面的VM在执行Get-PartitionSupportedSize -DiskNumber xx时，会有以下Invalid property的报错，报错的code为：0x80041031 如官方文档上的描述，执行磁盘压缩需要使用Get-SupportedSize 方法中的 SizeMin 参数查询 MSFT Partition API 来确定支持的最小大小。 操作步骤 / 命令 但是系统在执行命令时报错，导致无法获取磁盘大小，进而实现压缩。 如您的环境允许您测试一下的话，您可以参考我们之前为您提供的第三方文档的命令尝试下，看看是不是可以修复。 Winmgmt命令参考： 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 为客户提供了以下建议： 参考链接 根据官方文档： 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2023-2-16 搭建环境测试FSlogix磁盘压缩的功能是正常的。 测试账户ww登录后，复制一个大文件后，查看fslogix对应的文件共享中，profile的size变大。 删除文件， 并注销账号ww后，profile文件自动压缩。 从日志中可以看到相应的压缩记录，附件是我测试环境的详细日志信息。 排查： 查看客户提供的日志，发现日志中disk size reduced 都是0MB。 日志集中有大量的以下报错，从报错来看，无法获取文件的size。 从目前的排查情况来看，主机池里面的VM在执行Get-PartitionSupportedSize -DiskNumber xx时，会有以下Invalid property的报错，报错的code为：0x80041031 根据官方文档： 此问题应该是系统WMI的问题。 如官方文档上的描述，执行磁盘压缩需要使用Get-SupportedSize 方法中的 SizeMin 参数查询 MSFT Partition API 来确定支持的最小大小。 但是系统在执行命令时报错，导致无法获取磁盘大小，进而实现压缩。 为客户提供了以下建议： 如您的环境允许您测试一下的话，您可以参考我们之前为您提供的第三方文档的命令尝试下，看看是不是可以修复。 Winmgmt命令参考：

searchText: sentinel中转服务器接收日志时区不一致解决方案 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Microsoft Sentinel Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-11-25 15:50:56 JD 相关性: Defender/Sentinel/安全 一句话摘要 Johnny lee 问题现象 / 场景 Johnny lee 背景信息 Johnny lee 通过文档可以了解，日志是以纯文本形式发送，所以源日志是什么时间，中转服务器就记录什么时间，不能自动改为当前中转服务器的时区。 所以记录在中转服务器中的日志就是源服务器的时间戳。 正常需要通过配置让所有源和中转服务器统一时区，才能保证中转服务器中的日志时区正确。 但是客户不能修改其他源服务器时区，所以给客户提供了通过中转服务器接收到日志的时间替代源设备上日志的生成时间。 具体中转服务器配置如下： $ActionFileDefaultTemplate CustomFormat 、 实际测试延迟为1s： 当然我测试这两台虚拟机是在同一网段，如内网网络环境复杂，延迟可能会提高。 排查思路 初始问题是客户发现sentinel中已经阻止的ip日志还能查询到。 通过查询客户中转服务器syslog日志发现实际问题是中转服务器（时区是UTC）上日志的时区不对为CST。 通过查询文档CEF收集日志架构如下： 通过抓包也可以看到日志转发到中转服务器过程中是不携带时区标签的： $template CustomFormat,"%timegenerated:::date-rfc3339% %HOSTNAME% %syslogtag%%msg:::sp-if-no-1st-sp%%msg%\n" 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Johnny lee 2024-6-29 初始问题是客户发现sentinel中已经阻止的ip日志还能查询到。 通过查询客户中转服务器syslog日志发现实际问题是中转服务器（时区是UTC）上日志的时区不对为CST。 通过查询文档CEF收集日志架构如下： 通过文档可以了解，日志是以纯文本形式发送，所以源日志是什么时间，中转服务器就记录什么时间，不能自动改为当前中转服务器的时区。 通过抓包也可以看到日志转发到中转服务器过程中是不携带时区标签的： 所以记录在中转服务器中的日志就是源服务器的时间戳。 正常需要通过配置让所有源和中转服务器统一时区，才能保证中转服务器中的日志时区正确。 但是客户不能修改其他源服务器时区，所以给客户提供了通过中转服务器接收到日志的时间替代源设备上日志的生成时间。 具体中转服务器配置如下： $template CustomFormat,"%timegenerated:::date-rfc3339% %HOSTNAME% %syslogtag%%msg:::sp-if-no-1st-sp%%msg%\n" $ActionFileDefaultTemplate CustomFormat 、 实际测试延迟为1s： 当然我测试这两台虚拟机是在同一网段，如内网网络环境复杂，延迟可能会提高。

Memory management in the OS is a complicated matter. Some memory can be paged out, some memory can be compressed or cache. Some memory may be released back after the error happened. It’s impossible for us to speculate how the customer was using OS memory to determine what part of the OS thought was out of memory without a full dump of the machine, and even if we had that, it's likely that the memory usage was expected. Memory management in the OS is a complicated matter. Some memory can be paged out, some memory can be compressed or cache. Some memory may be released back after the error happened. It’s impossible for us to speculate how the customer was using OS memory to determine what part of the OS thought was out of memory without a full dump of the machine, and even if we had that, it's likely that the memory usage was expected. We suggest the customer increases the size of RAM in the VM to mitigate this. Normally you could check the following doc. searchText: [Share] DCR采集自定义JSON日志，举例将apache日志采集到LogA自定义表 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Monitor Section: KB 最近修改: 2025-12-08 10:52:45 JD 相关性: 监控/日志 一句话摘要 Case：20250317343722 问题现象 / 场景 Case：20250317343722 背景信息 问题背景： 测试后发现手动创建的快捷方式，特此分享。 可以随意找一个日志文件作为原始文件进行转换，转换文件条数不需要很多。以下为一个apache日志。 执行后即可将日志转换为JSON格式。 之后正常创建DCR和选择DCE，然后下一步即可看到创建自定义日志页面，选择浏览文件上传之前转换的JSON模板文件 上传后会看到提示说缺少一个时间字段，可以点击转换编辑器按钮将该字段加上。 source extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(Time) 创建后即可生成DCR，和自定义表。采集自定义JSON日志需要使用DCE，在推送数据时需要AD的应用程序具备DCR的至少时“监视指标发布者”权限，为了方便操作我分配的是参与者权限。 这个DCR的权限传播速度非常慢，大约在30分钟左右。 下图送执行结果可以看出当权限没传播完时会提示token没权限问题，等待即可。 推送成功后的效果 排查思路 需要注意在创建DCR时会涉及到使用portal创建Log A中的表的步骤，所以账户至少具备Log A的参与者权限。 然后即可在Log Analytics中创建新表。 添加语句，点击运行后可以查看到正常数据，然后点击应用即可。 DcrImmutableId 是DCR的不可变ID，portal上可见。 DceUri是DEC的日志引入URL，portal上可见 操作步骤 / 命令 通常使用DCR采集自定义的JSON格式日志时会遇到需要提前在Log Analytics中创建表的问题，但是需要手动编写JSON表结构，以及需要使用命令来创建比较麻烦。 根据官方文档编写转换脚本，此脚本可以将日志转换成JSON格式， 需要提前修改脚本中的信息，使用应用ID和应用密码的方式登录 执行命令：.\LogGenerator.ps1 -Log "apachelog" -Type "file" -Output "apachelog.json" 测试数据推送可以使用之前的PS脚本，将示例的apache文件作为数据文件手动推送即可。 推送命令：.\LogGenerator.ps1 -Log "1.log" -Type "API" -Table "testapi CL" -DcrImmutableId <immutable ID -DceUri <data collection 关于监控虚拟机（Windows和linux系统）的磁盘警报配置，可参考以下配置步骤： 背景信息 测试案例： 监测3台虚拟机的磁盘剩余空间（包括Windows和linux系统，hyper-v-2016是Windows系统，centos8和k8scontrol是linux系统），每5分钟，检测剩余空间小于或等于99的时候触发警报。 在数据收集规则中创建数据收集规则 填写规则名称，选择对应的订阅、资源组、区域，平台类型选择ALL，然后下一步 添加资源，选择要监控的虚拟机 在收集和传递中，点击添加数据源，选择性能计数器，在基本中，选择以下性能计数器 Perf where CounterName == "% Free Space" 如输出以下截图的指标，点击新建预警规则。 跳转到编辑预警规则界面， 度量值选择CounterValue 聚合类型选择平均 聚合粒度默认5分钟 按维度拆分，选择Computer，并选择在数据收集规则中的三台虚拟机 在第二个按维度拆分中，选择InstanceName，在维度值中选择检测/分区，C: D: E:四个维度值。 为了测试效果， 运算符选择小于或等于 评估频率选择5分钟 以上效果，将在每5分钟，检测剩余空间小于或等于99的时候触发警报。 下一步选择操作组，来触发报警邮件 在详细信息中，选择对应的订阅、资源组，严重性选择严重，并填写预警规则名称freedisk，选择区域，然后点击下一步 保存好之后，可在监视器的警报中，点击预警规则，搜索此预警规则 在等待5分钟后，会收到对应三台虚拟机的警报条件触发。 此时可在邮箱中，收到相应的警报信息，以下截图是三台VM对应的磁盘报警信息： 到此完成了，虚拟机磁盘剩余空间的检测警报。 排查思路 20230710240108 Premium FileStorage 监控咨询”。 背景信息 Hi All: 最近有客户问当前文件共享超过预配容量的80%时发送通知，做了些测试，给大家同步一下。 测试发现通过Get-AzMetric，对于标准存储账户，不能拆分各个File Share，只能取所有文件共享使用量的和。 $accountName = "hanasa" $accountKey = "7R4sMu7BsWhRXuzOamlJ1m4vd1goxxxxxxxq1OOKbu+bUtthfq50Puuk++AStECnu2Q==" 存储账户密钥 $shareName = "hanatest" 需要监视的文件共享 $toAddress = "liu.huan3@oe.21vianet.com" 收件人地址 $emailSubject = "File Share $shareName usage exceeded the limit" $emailBodyTemplate = "The current usage of File Share {0} is {1} GB, which has exceeded the {2}% of the quota {3} GB ." $ctx = New-AzStorageContext -StorageAccountName $accountName -StorageAccountKey $accountKey $share = Get-AzStorageShare -Name $shareName -Context $ctx $client = $share.ShareClient 获取文件共享的统计数据 $stats = $client.GetStatistics() $shareUsageInBytes = $stats.Value.ShareUsageInBytes $shareUsageInGiB = $shareUsageInBytes/1024/1024/1024 Write-Host "The file share usage is $shareUsageInGiB GB." 获取配额 $QuotaGiB = $share.Quota Write-Host "The file share quota is $QuotaGiB GB." 计算使用量百分比 $usagePercentage = $shareUsageInGiB / $QuotaGiB if ($usagePercentage -gt $limit) { $emailBody = [string]::Format($emailBodyTemplate, $shareName, $shareUsageInGiB, $limit 100 ,$QuotaGiB ) 发送警报邮件 $smtpCredential=new-object -typename System.Management.Automation.PSCredential -argumentlist "xxxxx@126.com",(ConvertTo-SecureString "VZPPxxxxTGBZGD" -AsPlainText -Force) 定义smtp服务器的凭据，绿色高亮部分为126邮箱SMTP授权码 Send-MailMessage -To $toAddress -From "xxxxx@126.com" -Subject $emailSubject -Body $emailBody -SmtpServer "smtp.126.com" -Credential $smtpCredential -Port "25" -UseSsl Write-Host "email sent to the $toAddress already " } else { Write-Host " not reach the limit, current usgae is $shareUsageInGiB, the quota is $QuotaGiB" } 本地测试收到的邮件情况 排查思路 查看存储账户下所有文件共享的使用量 Hi All: 最近有客户问当前文件共享超过预配容量的80%时发送通知，做了些测试，给大家同步一下。 测试发现通过Get-AzMetric，对于标准存储账户，不能拆分各个File Share，只能取所有文件共享使用量的和。 示例命令： 查看存储账户下所有文件共享的使用量 Get-AzMetric -ResourceId "/subscriptions/1447ccf1-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2f370d142fa6/resourceGroups/hanasa/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/hanasa/fileServices/default" -MetricName "FileCapacity" -AggregationType Total 查看存储账户下单个文件共享的使用量 Get-AzMetric -ResourceId "/subscriptions/1447ccf1-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2f370d142fa6/resourceGroups/hanasa/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/hanasa/fileServices/hanatest" -MetricName "FileCapacity" -AggregationType Total 在公网链接 中有人提到了与1中类似的情况，并提出可以使用Azure 存储文件SDK的方式来查看文件共享的使用量，我本地测试测试了一下是可以，然后做了如下的脚本。 $accountName = "hanasa" $accountKey = "7R4sMu7BsWhRXuzOamlJ1m4vd1goxxxxxxxq1OOKbu+bUtthfq50Puuk++AStECnu2Q==" 存储账户密钥 $shareName = "hanatest" 需要监视的文件共享 $limit = 0.1 警报阈值 $toAddress = "liu.huan3@oe.21vianet.com" 收件人地址 $emailSubject = "File Share $shareName usage exceeded the limit" $emailBodyTemplate = "The current usage of File Share {0} is {1} GB, which has exceeded the {2}% of the quota {3} GB ." $ctx = New-AzStorageContext -StorageAccountName $accountName -StorageAccountKey $accountKey $share = Get-AzStorageShare -Name $shareName -Context $ctx $client = $share.ShareClient 获取文件共享的统计数据 $stats = $client.GetStatistics() $shareUsageInBytes = $stats.Value.ShareUsageInBytes $shareUsageInGiB = $shareUsageInBytes/1024/1024/1024 Write-Host "The file share usage is $shareUsageInGiB GB." 获取配额 $QuotaGiB = $share.Quota Write-Host "The file share quota is $QuotaGiB GB." 计算使用量百分比 $usagePercentage = $shareUsageInGiB / $QuotaGiB 检查使用量是否超过阈值% if ($usagePercentage -gt $limit) { $emailBody = [string]::Format($emailBodyTemplate, $shareName, $shareUsageInGiB, $limit 100 ,$QuotaGiB ) 发送警报邮件 $smtpCredential=new-object -typename System.Management.Automation.PSCredential -argumentlist "xxxxx@126.com",(ConvertTo-SecureString "VZPPxxxxTGBZGD" -AsPlainText -Force) 定义smtp服务器的凭据，绿色高亮部分为126邮箱SMTP授权码 Send-MailMessage -To $toAddress -From "xxxxx@126.com" -Subject $emailSubject -Body $emailBody -SmtpServer "smtp.126.com" -Credential $smtpCredential -Port "25" -UseSsl Write-Host "email sent to the $toAddress already " } else { Write-Host " not reach the limit, current usgae is $shareUsageInGiB, the quota is $QuotaGiB" } 本地测试收到的邮件情况 另外，曦哥还提供了另外一种思路，把文件共享挂载到虚拟机中，然后监视虚拟机中对应的挂载点（或磁盘）的使用率来宾指标，更多请参考曦哥的工单“SR 20230710240108 Premium FileStorage 监控咨询”。

searchText: 【Share】Azure警报操作组无法为企业微信等特定架构发送消息及解决方案 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Monitor Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-06-26 17:06:00 JD 相关性: 监控/日志 一句话摘要 客户在Azure monitor警报操作组中添加Webhook调用企业微信机器人后，无法在企业微信中接收到警报信息。 问题现象 / 场景 客户在Azure monitor警报操作组中添加Webhook调用企业微信机器人后，无法在企业微信中接收到警报信息。 Azure 警报发送的请求 Body中并没有msgtype参数，导致企业微信无法接收到信息： 企业微信对msgtype参数属于特定架构，Azure警报负载无法满足此特定架构。 背景信息 Update Wang Yu 问题描述： ======== 先对操作组进行测试，看到使用样例警报内容，对Webhook操作是成功的。 发送应用消息 - 文档 - 企业微信开发者中心 (qq.com) 配置 Webhook 以获取活动日志警报 - Azure Monitor Azure Docs 对于特定架构接口，需要使用逻辑应用来操作。 在操作组中先调用逻辑应用，在逻辑应用中封装msgtype参数，之后由逻辑应用调用企业微信。 在工单中客户调用自己的接口后封装可以成功调用到企业微信。 排查思路 排查过程： 进一步排查，企业微信消息文本接口中"msgtype"参数是必须的： 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 解决方案： 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Update Wang Yu 问题描述： ======== 客户在Azure monitor警报操作组中添加Webhook调用企业微信机器人后，无法在企业微信中接收到警报信息。 排查过程： 先对操作组进行测试，看到使用样例警报内容，对Webhook操作是成功的。 进一步排查，企业微信消息文本接口中"msgtype"参数是必须的： 发送应用消息 - 文档 - 企业微信开发者中心 (qq.com) Azure 警报发送的请求 Body中并没有msgtype参数，导致企业微信无法接收到信息： 配置 Webhook 以获取活动日志警报 - Azure Monitor Azure Docs 解决方案： 企业微信对msgtype参数属于特定架构，Azure警报负载无法满足此特定架构。 对于特定架构接口，需要使用逻辑应用来操作。 在操作组中先调用逻辑应用，在逻辑应用中封装msgtype参数，之后由逻辑应用调用企业微信。 在工单中客户调用自己的接口后封装可以成功调用到企业微信。

searchText: 【Share】DCR计数器的空格字符串检查问题 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Monitor Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-08-21 18:10:28 JD 相关性: 监控/日志 一句话摘要 客户在Azure China有两个订阅，他在配置虚拟机磁盘空间不足的警报的时候发现维度值Dimension无法选择具体的 盘符，例如C:\ D:\ 等。 问题现象 / 场景 客户在Azure China有两个订阅，他在配置虚拟机磁盘空间不足的警报的时候发现维度值Dimension无法选择具体的 盘符，例如C:\ D:\ 等。 背景信息 分享案例：SR 20240805308314 Low disk space alert not appearing all the drive letter. Perf summarize AggregatedValue = min(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), Computer, InstanceName 从此处引出一个不容易被发现的坑： 后续客户反馈，一个订阅添加之后成功了，但第二个订阅添加后仍然没生效，还是看不到具体的盘符。 接下来我进行了测试，故意添加空格的计数器： 点击添加后，发现我仍然能通过没加空格的计数器名称来搜索到尾巴有空格的计数器：（例如输入ABC，可以搜到ABCD） 由于计数器页面没有删除按钮，于是我在数据源处删除了性能计数器，重新全部添加一遍： 排查思路 通过客户的查询语句，未在LAW中查询得到盘符的Free Space，只有默认加总百分比 Total where ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "% Free Space" 进而检查DCR的指标配置的Counter，提供在数据源的Performance Counters里面手动添加 \LogicalDisk( )\% Free Space 的方案，星号 才会将虚拟机的所有盘符/分区进行区分收集，不然默认的只有 Total的总百分比。 问题原因：\LogicalDisk( )\% Free Space 的计数器添加的时候尾部有空格，导致识别为字符串的一部分，此计数器未成功添加。在门户检查已添加的计数器还看不到尾巴的空格，只有后台ASC能看到JSON模版的双引号之内的尾部空格。 通过客户反馈的信息、截图，以及会议上各方面的检查沟通，都没有发现不一样的问题。 结果通过后台检查DCR的Counter，发现有问题的那个最后有空格： 后台查看我测试的，的确是尾巴有空格，然后query查看也只有 Total，复现客户问题： 注意正确添加没有空格的 \LogicalDisk( )\% Free Space 检查后台DCR的计数器，已经没有空格： 检查日志，已经可以看到不同盘符： 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 分享案例：SR 20240805308314 Low disk space alert not appearing all the drive letter. 客户在Azure China有两个订阅，他在配置虚拟机磁盘空间不足的警报的时候发现维度值Dimension无法选择具体的 盘符，例如C:\ D:\ 等。 通过客户的查询语句，未在LAW中查询得到盘符的Free Space，只有默认加总百分比 Total Perf where ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "% Free Space" summarize AggregatedValue = min(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), Computer, InstanceName 进而检查DCR的指标配置的Counter，提供在数据源的Performance Counters里面手动添加 \LogicalDisk( )\% Free Space 的方案，星号 才会将虚拟机的所有盘符/分区进行区分收集，不然默认的只有 Total的总百分比。 从此处引出一个不容易被发现的坑： 后续客户反馈，一个订阅添加之后成功了，但第二个订阅添加后仍然没生效，还是看不到具体的盘符。 问题原因：\LogicalDisk( )\% Free Space 的计数器添加的时候尾部有空格，导致识别为字符串的一部分，此计数器未成功添加。在门户检查已添加的计数器还看不到尾巴的空格，只有后台ASC能看到JSON模版的双引号之内的尾部空格。 通过客户反馈的信息、截图，以及会议上各方面的检查沟通，都没有发现不一样的问题。 结果通过后台检查DCR的Counter，发现有问题的那个最后有空格： 接下来我进行了测试，故意添加空格的计数器： 点击添加后，发现我仍然能通过没加空格的计数器名称来搜索到尾巴有空格的计数器：（例如输入ABC，可以搜到ABCD） 后台查看我测试的，的确是尾巴有空格，然后query查看也只有 Total，复现客户问题： 由于计数器页面没有删除按钮，于是我在数据源处删除了性能计数器，重新全部添加一遍： 注意正确添加没有空格的 \LogicalDisk( )\% Free Space 检查后台DCR的计数器，已经没有空格： 检查日志，已经可以看到不同盘符：

searchText: 20230130 关于Ubuntu 6.2 内核 导致Azure虚拟机资源健康状态异常告警的事宜 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Azure Monitor Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-12-20 10:44:34 JD 相关性: 监控/日志 一句话摘要 一直收到虚拟机的资源健康告警，告警多台虚拟机不可用，但是虚拟机的业务运行正常。 问题现象 / 场景 一直收到虚拟机的资源健康告警，告警多台虚拟机不可用，但是虚拟机的业务运行正常。 虽然虚拟机正常运行，系统内部运行健康状况良好，但是在Azure门户上显示的虚拟机状态为不可用。重新部署虚拟机无法解决此问题。 We identified this issue is caused due to a recently discovered bug in Canonical 6.2 kernel which impacts the Platform ID field passed to Hyper-V host during VM start up. This field is used by the host to determine VM health status. The bug is only present in Canonical / Ubuntu's 6.2 kernel. Canonical Team is working on a fix and is expected to be available in the coming weeks. 背景信息 升级的第一个工单为：SR 20231103260877[MS-LED]/Smart Team Global Software Tech (Shanghai) Co., Ltd./Resource health is unavailable for a month, but the server is running well - TrackingID 2311080010001301 CSS给出的PG回复为： 问题描述： 问题原因： ubuntu官方说明文档： 如果需要立即解决问题，可以降级到包含版本5.15内核的linux-azure-lts-22.04软件包，以解决此问题。 同时，今日与CSS TA开会也讨论了这个问题，他们分享了PG的原文回复如下： 及VM guest agent workflow： 排查思路 近期咱们接到Azure虚拟机资源健康状态异常报警的工单，目前收到客户反馈问题的操作系统都是Ubuntu虚拟机。如果后续有遇到类似问题，可以先查看一下操作系统是否为：Ubuntu 6.2内核的。 Azure Compute teams have completed the investigation involving Virtual Machine <VMNAME . The VM Status on the Azure portal shows as Unavailable even though the VM is healthy and running fine. Redeploying the VM does not fix this issue. We apologize for the inconvenience this caused you. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 此问题是由于最近在Ubuntu 6.2内核中发现的一个错误引起的，该错误影响了虚拟机启动期间传递给Hyper-V主机的平台ID字段。该字段由主机用于确定虚拟机的健康状态。该错误仅存在于Canonical / Ubuntu的6.2内核中。Canonical团队正在努力修复，预计将在未来几周内提供修复程序。 您可以通过uname -r查看的虚拟机使用的内核版本，或者在门户上查看serial console log，vm-java-prod-001使用的内核版本为6.2.0-1012。 解决方法： 不过由于暂时没有产生业务影响，建议等待Canonical团队的官方修复。 Workaround: If an immediate resolution is needed downgrading to the linux-azure-lts-22.04 package which contains version 5.15 kernel will resolve the issue. 参考链接 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 近期咱们接到Azure虚拟机资源健康状态异常报警的工单，目前收到客户反馈问题的操作系统都是Ubuntu虚拟机。如果后续有遇到类似问题，可以先查看一下操作系统是否为：Ubuntu 6.2内核的。 升级的第一个工单为：SR 20231103260877[MS-LED]/Smart Team Global Software Tech (Shanghai) Co., Ltd./Resource health is unavailable for a month, but the server is running well - TrackingID 2311080010001301 CSS给出的PG回复为： 问题描述： 一直收到虚拟机的资源健康告警，告警多台虚拟机不可用，但是虚拟机的业务运行正常。 虽然虚拟机正常运行，系统内部运行健康状况良好，但是在Azure门户上显示的虚拟机状态为不可用。重新部署虚拟机无法解决此问题。 问题原因： 此问题是由于最近在Ubuntu 6.2内核中发现的一个错误引起的，该错误影响了虚拟机启动期间传递给Hyper-V主机的平台ID字段。该字段由主机用于确定虚拟机的健康状态。该错误仅存在于Canonical / Ubuntu的6.2内核中。Canonical团队正在努力修复，预计将在未来几周内提供修复程序。 ubuntu官方说明文档： 您可以通过uname -r查看的虚拟机使用的内核版本，或者在门户上查看serial console log，vm-java-prod-001使用的内核版本为6.2.0-1012。 解决方法： 如果需要立即解决问题，可以降级到包含版本5.15内核的linux-azure-lts-22.04软件包，以解决此问题。 不过由于暂时没有产生业务影响，建议等待Canonical团队的官方修复。 同时，今日与CSS TA开会也讨论了这个问题，他们分享了PG的原文回复如下： Azure Compute teams have completed the investigation involving Virtual Machine <VMNAME .
