searchText: 存储账户设置加密时开启客户管理的密钥（选择系统分配标识）报错解决办法 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2025-05-30 10:23:23 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 在存储账户加密位置选择客户管理的密钥，选择系统分配标识，点击保存一般会报错。 原因以及解决方式如下： 问题现象 / 场景 在存储账户加密位置选择客户管理的密钥，选择系统分配标识，点击保存一般会报错。 原因以及解决方式如下： 虽然点击保存报错， 但是这同时也帮您为存储账户创建了系统托管标识，系统托管标识名称和资源实例名称一致。 此时，报错后， 只需要在给存储账户的系统托管标识 在key vault 实例 范围分配密钥保管库管理员角色，再次在存储账户加密位置点击保存即可。 背景信息 原因： 存储账户作为调用方，需要对被调用方 key vault 实例具有适当角色，如密钥保管库管理员。 因此需要给存储账户的系统托管标识 在key vault 实例 范围分配密钥保管库管理员角色。 但是门户下存储账户没有开启系统托管标识的位置。 解决办法： 分配角色： 再次点击保存成功： 排查思路 未从原文中明确识别。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 在存储账户加密位置选择客户管理的密钥，选择系统分配标识，点击保存一般会报错。 原因以及解决方式如下： 原因： 存储账户作为调用方，需要对被调用方 key vault 实例具有适当角色，如密钥保管库管理员。 因此需要给存储账户的系统托管标识 在key vault 实例 范围分配密钥保管库管理员角色。 但是门户下存储账户没有开启系统托管标识的位置。 解决办法： 虽然点击保存报错， 但是这同时也帮您为存储账户创建了系统托管标识，系统托管标识名称和资源实例名称一致。 此时，报错后， 只需要在给存储账户的系统托管标识 在key vault 实例 范围分配密钥保管库管理员角色，再次在存储账户加密位置点击保存即可。 分配角色： 再次点击保存成功：

searchText: 当LVM 的PV为未分区的磁盘时，磁盘在门户上扩容后，如何扩容LVM文件系统 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2022-03-16 09:50:41 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 参考工单：SR 2019092553304 [MS-LED]第二块磁盘LVM扩容失败 问题现象 / 场景 参考工单：SR 2019092553304 [MS-LED]第二块磁盘LVM扩容失败 问题：客户将数据磁盘在门户上由760G扩容到1.2T后，发现磁盘之前做了LVM，是直接将磁盘（磁盘并没有分区）加入到PV，然后在LVM中创建的文件系统。fdisk -l发现没有分区表，创建分区会影响现有环境的数据，LVM无法扩容。 背景信息 2019--9-25 [root@mhspbicdh05 cdhuser] fdisk /dev/sdc Welcome to fdisk (util-linux 2.23.2). Changes will remain in memory only, until you decide to write them. Be careful before using the write command. Device does not contain a recognized partition table Building a new DOS disklabel with disk identifier 0x3e27172f. Command (m for help): d No partition is defined yet! Command (m for help): 经研究发现使用pvresize可以解决此问题。 测试过程如下： 1. 在门户上附加了一块760G的数据磁盘，然后在系统中创建LVM 2. 挂载并创建了一个测试文件test.txt 4. 执行pvresize /dev/sdd 6．执行lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/vg03/lv03 ，扩展lv 8． 使用resize2fs /dev/vg03/lv03 拉伸文件系统。 xfs系统使用xfs growfs 9．文件系统拉伸完成 排查思路 查找了下，官网上的步骤也是直接加入磁盘到PV 3．在门户上对磁盘进行扩容到1023G，登陆到系统中使用lsblk查看设备已经扩容，使用pvs,vgs,lvs查看还是原来的大小 5．查看pv和vg的大小都已经更改，lv还是原来的大小 7.再次lvs查看，发现已经扩容了。文件系统还是原来的大小。 10. 查看数据是保留的。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2019--9-25 参考工单：SR 2019092553304 [MS-LED]第二块磁盘LVM扩容失败 问题：客户将数据磁盘在门户上由760G扩容到1.2T后，发现磁盘之前做了LVM，是直接将磁盘（磁盘并没有分区）加入到PV，然后在LVM中创建的文件系统。fdisk -l发现没有分区表，创建分区会影响现有环境的数据，LVM无法扩容。 [root@mhspbicdh05 cdhuser] fdisk /dev/sdc Welcome to fdisk (util-linux 2.23.2). Changes will remain in memory only, until you decide to write them. Be careful before using the write command. Device does not contain a recognized partition table Building a new DOS disklabel with disk identifier 0x3e27172f. Command (m for help): d No partition is defined yet! Command (m for help): 查找了下，官网上的步骤也是直接加入磁盘到PV 经研究发现使用pvresize可以解决此问题。 测试过程如下： 1. 在门户上附加了一块760G的数据磁盘，然后在系统中创建LVM 2. 挂载并创建了一个测试文件test.txt 3．在门户上对磁盘进行扩容到1023G，登陆到系统中使用lsblk查看设备已经扩容，使用pvs,vgs,lvs查看还是原来的大小 4. 执行pvresize /dev/sdd 5．查看pv和vg的大小都已经更改，lv还是原来的大小 6．执行lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/vg03/lv03 ，扩展lv 7.再次lvs查看，发现已经扩容了。文件系统还是原来的大小。 8． 使用resize2fs /dev/vg03/lv03 拉伸文件系统。 xfs系统使用xfs growfs 9．文件系统拉伸完成 10. 查看数据是保留的。

每个作业最多可以寄送10个硬盘(意味着如果客户需要向同一个存储账户内导入200T以上的数据，需要通过多个作业进行操作)。 客户端工具 下载链接为此处。 此工具仅支持64位Windows操作系统，具体操作系统版本请参考文档。 硬盘部分 只支持3.5寸SATA2或SATA3机械硬盘，硬盘容量最大支持10TB。 只支持NTFS格式的数据卷。 导入服务只会读取每块硬盘的第一个数据卷。 searchText: 扩容centos7.5的xfs根分区与2T以上的数据磁盘 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2023-12-19 00:28:50 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 这里更推荐大家使用"xfs growfs /"即使用"mount-point"目录代替磁盘设备名称，否则有可能出现如下报错 问题现象 / 场景 这里更推荐大家使用"xfs growfs /"即使用"mount-point"目录代替磁盘设备名称，否则有可能出现如下报错 在print时如果提示如下报错请先输入ignore再输入fix即可。 背景信息 Jia Xiaolei 此文档用于扩容已使用的linux centos环境，扩容xfs格式的根分区，以及大于2T的数据磁盘，保证数据不丢失进行动态扩容。 1，扩容前环境 3，扩容根分区 保存成功后输入reboot重启操作系统，重新登录虚拟机，此时输入df –lh看到sda2挂在的根分区还没有改变，输入xfs growfs /dev/sda2对sda2进行扩容。 Congratulation，此时根分区已扩容成功,继续下面扩容数据磁盘的操作吧！ 4，扩容数据磁盘 首先需要取消数据磁盘的挂载，我这里挂在目录为/data。umount /data 如果之前配置过数据磁盘fstab的自动挂载，请先保存挂载配置后将其删除，防止重启后自动挂载数据磁盘。 输入parted /dev/sdc为sdc1进行扩容，输入resizepart 1来修改sdc1的大小，默认修改为最高，如需指定大小可参考/dev/sdc的总大小，修改成功后输入q退出。并reboot操作系统。 bl 使用之前备份的fstab语句恢复之前的fstab文件。 排查思路 登陆虚拟机，使用fdisk /dev/sda查看系统磁盘情况，此时看到修改后的大小已更改，此时需要更改sda2的大小。输入p，查看sda分区情况。 输入d 再输入 2 ，直接将sda2删除，在出入p查看，此时sda2已删除。 输入n 新建分区，输入p选择分区后面3项均使用默认项，再次输入p查看，可看到此时sda2分区大小已改变。确认后输入w进行保存。 输入parted进入(parted)模式，输入select /dev/sdc来选定数据磁盘，输入print来查看分区情况 登陆虚拟机，先输入blkid /dev/sdc1查看sdc1的UUID，然后使用mount手工将sdc1挂载，然后使用resize2fs /dev/sdc1进行扩容,成功后使用df –lh查看磁盘，此时已变为4T. 操作步骤 / 命令 备注：如果从fdisk分区的2T转换为parted分区时，由于parted只能识别gpt格式的磁盘，此时在parted /dev/xxx后需要执行mklabel gpt将磁盘格式转换。此时会自动清除分区，之后需要使用mkpart进行分区，例如：mkpart primary 0 -1,此命令表示将一个磁盘分一个区 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 2，停止虚拟机，修改磁盘大小，将系统盘修改为60G,数据磁盘修改为4T 参考链接 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2018-08-07 Jia Xiaolei 2019-07-18 此文档用于扩容已使用的linux centos环境，扩容xfs格式的根分区，以及大于2T的数据磁盘，保证数据不丢失进行动态扩容。 1，扩容前环境 2，停止虚拟机，修改磁盘大小，将系统盘修改为60G,数据磁盘修改为4T 3，扩容根分区 登陆虚拟机，使用fdisk /dev/sda查看系统磁盘情况，此时看到修改后的大小已更改，此时需要更改sda2的大小。输入p，查看sda分区情况。 输入d 再输入 2 ，直接将sda2删除，在出入p查看，此时sda2已删除。 输入n 新建分区，输入p选择分区后面3项均使用默认项，再次输入p查看，可看到此时sda2分区大小已改变。确认后输入w进行保存。 保存成功后输入reboot重启操作系统，重新登录虚拟机，此时输入df –lh看到sda2挂在的根分区还没有改变，输入xfs growfs /dev/sda2对sda2进行扩容。 这里更推荐大家使用"xfs growfs /"即使用"mount-point"目录代替磁盘设备名称，否则有可能出现如下报错 Congratulation，此时根分区已扩容成功,继续下面扩容数据磁盘的操作吧！ 4，扩容数据磁盘 首先需要取消数据磁盘的挂载，我这里挂在目录为/data。umount /data 输入parted进入(parted)模式，输入select /dev/sdc来选定数据磁盘，输入print来查看分区情况 在print时如果提示如下报错请先输入ignore再输入fix即可。 如果之前配置过数据磁盘fstab的自动挂载，请先保存挂载配置后将其删除，防止重启后自动挂载数据磁盘。 输入parted /dev/sdc为sdc1进行扩容，输入resizepart 1来修改sdc1的大小，默认修改为最高，如需指定大小可参考/dev/sdc的总大小，修改成功后输入q退出。并reboot操作系统。 登陆虚拟机，先输入blkid /dev/sdc1查看sdc1的UUID，然后使用mount手工将sdc1挂载，然后使用resize2fs /dev/sdc1进行扩容,成功后使用df –lh查看磁盘，此时已变为4T. bl 使用之前备份的fstab语句恢复之前的fstab文件。 备注：如果从fdisk分区的2T转换为parted分区时，由于parted只能识别gpt格式的磁盘，此时在parted /dev/xxx后需要执行mklabel gpt将磁盘格式转换。此时会自动清除分区，之后需要使用mkpart进行分区，例如：mkpart primary 0 -1,此命令表示将一个磁盘分一个区

searchText: 显示Blob有删除的快照，但实际上没有对Blob创建过快照 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2023-04-23 13:55:16 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 问题描述： 问题现象 / 场景 问题描述： 背景信息 问题描述： 客户发现删除一个blob时，提示有关联的快照，但是没有创建过快照。 发现Show deleted shapshots中有很多Deleted的快照，但是发现客户 排查思路 分析排查： 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 同时，发现存储账户的Data protection中的Enable soft delete for blobs并没有开启。 解决方案： 最终发现，在Enable soft delete for blobs的情况下，当对blob文件进行编辑后，就会产生deleted的快照。 经过排查客户的操作记录，发现客户之前有Enable soft delete for blobs，在问题发生前几天，禁用了该功能。 大家可以通过ASC上的Setting History查询一些存储账户内部功能的设置记录，排查中发现ASC本身显示的记录可能不全，需要点开下面的Jarvis链接，进一步确认下。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2023-4-23 问题描述： 客户发现删除一个blob时，提示有关联的快照，但是没有创建过快照。 分析排查： 发现Show deleted shapshots中有很多Deleted的快照，但是发现客户 同时，发现存储账户的Data protection中的Enable soft delete for blobs并没有开启。 解决方案： 最终发现，在Enable soft delete for blobs的情况下，当对blob文件进行编辑后，就会产生deleted的快照。 经过排查客户的操作记录，发现客户之前有Enable soft delete for blobs，在问题发生前几天，禁用了该功能。 大家可以通过ASC上的Setting History查询一些存储账户内部功能的设置记录，排查中发现ASC本身显示的记录可能不全，需要点开下面的Jarvis链接，进一步确认下。

searchText: Assisting customers with Data Box POD order status inquiries 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-15 07:00:31 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Common Data Box POD Order Creation Issues 问题现象 / 场景 Common Data Box POD Order Creation Issues Some of the most commonly asked issues regarding the status of a Data Box POD job include the following: 背景信息 Microsoft Stream Data Box Model not Available The Data Box service does not currently support all customer countries and regions. The service also supports data ingestion or egress only within the same country/region as the destination, and won't cross any international borders. The only exception is for orders in the European Union (EU), where Data Boxes can ship to and from any EU country/region. For information regarding region availability for the Azure Data Box service, go to: Azure Products by Region For detailed and updated information, go to: Order Data Box Could not Create Data Box Order In order to create a Data Box order, the following is required: A Microsoft Azure storage account with access credentials, such as the storage account name and access key. An Azure subscription of one of the following types: Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA) for new subscriptions or Microsoft Enterprise Agreement (EA) for existing subscriptions. Read more about MCA for new subscriptions and EA subscriptions. Microsoft Azure Sponsorship Microsoft Partner Network (MPN) Owner or contributor access to the Azure subscription For detailed and updated information, go to: Prerequisites for service Could not Create Additional Data Box Orders The Data Box service limits each Azure subscription to 5 active Data Box orders. For detailed and updated information, go to: Data Box subscription limits When will I receive the Data Box? 排查思路 Could not Validate Address The Data Box service uses the UPS Address Validator to validate customer addresses. Ensure the address is formatted correctly, then use the Validator to confirm that the address is valid. If the address is valid, but the issue still occurs when creating the Data Box order, raise an IcM with the Data Box SaaS team for assistance. Use Lens or ASC to check the status of a Data Box job. Tracking information can be found and relayed to the customer once the device has been shipped. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 Cloud Solution Provider (CSP). searchText: azure 存储账户网络防火墙特性 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-12-26 14:09:12 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 1 . 不能通过telnet 存储账户的 ip+端口 来判断存储账户是否放通客户端的网络： Azure 存储账户的 网络防火墙 是七层的， 即使选择为 “已从所选虚拟网络和 IP 地址启用”，不论白名单是否 问题现象 / 场景 1 . 不能通过telnet 存储账户的 ip+端口 来判断存储账户是否放通客户端的网络： Azure 存储账户的 网络防火墙 是七层的， 即使选择为 “已从所选虚拟网络和 IP 地址启用”，不论白名单是否 背景信息 2 . 以防火墙添加白名单的角度，存储账户抓的是收到的api 请求的 source ip ，即存储账户防火墙还是通过网络层的实际源 IP 来执行访问控制. 并不是通过http 协议中的X-Forwarded-For 来判断客户端位置。 3 访问存储账户的azure 资源 如果和存储账户在同一个区域， 这种设计的好处是访问不出公网， 既快又安全。 以 vm 为例，vm和存储账户在同一个区域， 存储账户的访问日志抓到的 api 请求的 源ip 是vm 的内网ip。 这种场景中 ，如果存储账户开启了防火墙，那么将vm 的公网ip 添加到存储账户网络的白名单也是没有意义的，这种情况可以考虑为存储账户设置专用终结点 ，专用终结点 vnet 选择为 vm 的vnet. 排查思路 分享一个查看blob 诊断设置日志的小技巧： Blob 诊断设置日志 是有规律的，每一个字段都是通过 分号分隔的， 将整个日志的 分号替换为逗号，将文件改为 .csv 格式，查看会方便很多。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 1 . 不能通过telnet 存储账户的 ip+端口 来判断存储账户是否放通客户端的网络： Azure 存储账户的 网络防火墙 是七层的， 即使选择为 “已从所选虚拟网络和 IP 地址启用”，不论白名单是否 添加客户端出口公网ip，telnet 存储账户 url +端口， 都是通的。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 1 . 不能通过telnet 存储账户的 ip+端口 来判断存储账户是否放通客户端的网络： Azure 存储账户的 网络防火墙 是七层的， 即使选择为 “已从所选虚拟网络和 IP 地址启用”，不论白名单是否 添加客户端出口公网ip，telnet 存储账户 url +端口， 都是通的。 2 . 以防火墙添加白名单的角度，存储账户抓的是收到的api 请求的 source ip ，即存储账户防火墙还是通过网络层的实际源 IP 来执行访问控制. 并不是通过http 协议中的X-Forwarded-For 来判断客户端位置。 分享一个查看blob 诊断设置日志的小技巧： Blob 诊断设置日志 是有规律的，每一个字段都是通过 分号分隔的， 将整个日志的 分号替换为逗号，将文件改为 .csv 格式，查看会方便很多。 3 访问存储账户的azure 资源 如果和存储账户在同一个区域， 这种设计的好处是访问不出公网， 既快又安全。 以 vm 为例，vm和存储账户在同一个区域， 存储账户的访问日志抓到的 api 请求的 源ip 是vm 的内网ip。 这种场景中 ，如果存储账户开启了防火墙，那么将vm 的公网ip 添加到存储账户网络的白名单也是没有意义的，这种情况可以考虑为存储账户设置专用终结点 ，专用终结点 vnet 选择为 vm 的vnet.

searchText: Azure数据盘传输数据卡顿现象分析 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Trouble Shooting 最近修改: 2021-10-25 10:21:47 JD 相关性: 售后排障; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 问题现象：2台D32s v3数据盘（2T SSD）之间通过共享方式拷贝大文件数据出现卡顿，传输速率频繁降为0 bytes/s。 问题现象 / 场景 问题现象：2台D32s v3数据盘（2T SSD）之间通过共享方式拷贝大文件数据出现卡顿，传输速率频繁降为0 bytes/s。 测试结果：每当目标机器（B）数据盘“HOST CACHING”配置为“Read/Write”时，在执行大文件传输及频繁写入期间会导致磁盘写入Pending或卡顿。 问题原因：硬盘写入缓存功能可以加快硬盘的读写速度，根据写缓存原理，数据会暂时存储在缓存，硬盘会在空闲（不进行读取或写入的时候）时再将缓存中的数据写入到盘片上。但由于特殊情况下有大量数据写入以致瓶颈，此时系统无法再继续处理缓存写入，造成写入Pending，并优先处理缓存数据到永久磁盘（数据盘），体现为数据写入卡顿/传输速率频繁降为0 bytes/s。 使用文件拷贝的方式无法科学地衡量磁盘的性能。 背景信息 LuYitong 搭建测试：模拟贵方实际测试场景，搭建了2台VM（同一虚拟网络），通过UNC:\\共享路径访问模式，从A机器数据盘（只读缓存）àB机器数据盘 （读写缓存）进行数据传输（200G大文件）。 缓存配置： 设置为无 ：如果你的应用基本都是写入，或者超过80%以上的都是写入操作，则缓存设置为无。 设置为读写：如果你的程序可以处理缓存数据，并且在需要的时候可以将缓存数据写入到持久化磁盘，对应用程序有较高要求，处理不当可能会有数据损失（例如突然断电）。 需要根据用户具体应用的实际情况进行正确设置获得最佳性能。 备注信息： 附上截图： 排查思路 近期在处理工单时，客户反应在2台Azure数据磁盘之间传输数据出现卡顿/传输速率频繁降为0bytes/s。经查看文档和多次测试，现象分析如下： 但是，并非所有 VM 都支持缓存，因此请查看 VM 说明了解你感兴趣的 VM 的大小及更多信息，支持缓存的 VM 将在其说明中以“最大缓存和临时存储吞吐量”度量进行指示。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 设置为只读：这个选项是Premium Storage的默认选项也是最为常见的选项，如果你的应用操作是读写的，或者只读的操作,建议使用该选项。 相关建议： 参考链接 对于读取频繁或只读数据磁盘（如 SQL Server 数据文件），可将磁盘缓存策略设置为 ReadOnly。对于写入频繁或只写数据磁盘（如 SQL Server 日志文件），可将磁盘缓存策略设置为 None。具体请参考： 测定Azure虚机磁盘性能官方文档，供参考： 。 searchText: Blob生命周期管理的过滤规则设置 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-11-11 09:48:59 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Update 问题现象 / 场景 Update 背景信息 Update Zhang Lihong 环境：Azure Blob，1个存储账户下有3个Container 问题： 其中1个Container中的所有文件、目录满足创建时间满1年的条件就删除。另外2个Container不受该规则影响。在生命周期Rule的Blob prefix写 container/ 是否能实现？ 如果容器下面的子文件夹中的文件都被删除了，子文件夹是否也会被删除的问题。 1.前缀字符串不支持通配符匹配。 前缀匹配字符串（如 container1/） 适用于名为 container1 的容器中的所有 blob。 container1 的前缀匹配字符串（不带尾部正斜杠字符 (/)）适用于容器名称以字符串 container1 开头的所有容器中的所有 blob。 此前缀将匹配名为 container11、container1234、container1ab 之类的容器。 参考文档: 2.根据测试结果，如果容器下面的子文件夹中的文件都被删除了，子文件夹也会被删除。 以下测试截图供您参考： 为了便于说明问题，我开启了blob软删除。 排查思路 未从原文中明确识别。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 解决方案： 参考链接 参考文档： 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Update Zhang Lihong 环境：Azure Blob，1个存储账户下有3个Container 问题： 其中1个Container中的所有文件、目录满足创建时间满1年的条件就删除。另外2个Container不受该规则影响。在生命周期Rule的Blob prefix写 container/ 是否能实现？ 如果容器下面的子文件夹中的文件都被删除了，子文件夹是否也会被删除的问题。 解决方案： 1.前缀字符串不支持通配符匹配。 参考文档： 前缀匹配字符串（如 container1/） 适用于名为 container1 的容器中的所有 blob。 container1 的前缀匹配字符串（不带尾部正斜杠字符 (/)）适用于容器名称以字符串 container1 开头的所有容器中的所有 blob。 此前缀将匹配名为 container11、container1234、container1ab 之类的容器。 参考文档: 2.根据测试结果，如果容器下面的子文件夹中的文件都被删除了，子文件夹也会被删除。 以下测试截图供您参考： 为了便于说明问题，我开启了blob软删除。

searchText: Cabling and configuring a Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-06 07:19:33 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 The steps for cabling and basic configuration of a Data Box device are: 问题现象 / 场景 The steps for cabling and basic configuration of a Data Box device are: 背景信息 The steps for cabling and basic configuration of a Data Box device are: Connect power and network cables Use an RJ45 cable to connect the MGMT port on the Data Box directly to a PC or laptop Power on the device Configure the Ethernet adapter on the PC or laptop with a static IP of 192.168.100.5 and subnet mask 255.255.255.0 For more information, see Cable and connect to your Azure Data Box. searchText: Connecting to and unlocking Data Box Disk 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box Disk 最近修改: 2022-04-07 06:09:12 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Connect to the Data Box Disk: 问题现象 / 场景 Connect to the Data Box Disk: 背景信息 Connect to the Data Box Disk: Use the included cable to connect the disk to a Windows/Linux machine running a supported version. For detailed and updated information of this product, refer to: Connect to disks and get the passkey To unlock the disk: Download and extract operating system-specific Data Box Disk unlock tool on the computer used to copy the data to disks. The drive letter assigned to the disk is displayed by the tool. Make a note of the disk drive letter. This is used in the subsequent steps. For detailed and updated information of this product, refer to: Unlock disks on Windows client or Unlock disks on Linux client. 排查思路 In the Azure portal, go to General Device Details and get the passkey. Run the Data Box Disk Unlock tool and supply the passkey. For any disk reinserts, run the unlock tool again and provide the passkey. Do not use the BitLocker dialog or the BitLocker key to unlock the disk. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Connect to the Data Box Disk: Use the included cable to connect the disk to a Windows/Linux machine running a supported version. searchText: Copy data for import to Azure Files, blobs, or page blobs 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box Disk 最近修改: 2022-04-07 06:25:49 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 View the contents of the unlocked drive. The list of the precreated folders and subfolders in the drive is different depending upon the options selected when placing the Data Box Disk order. If a precreated folder does not exist, do not create it as copying to... 问题现象 / 场景 View the contents of the unlocked drive. The list of the precreated folders and subfolders in the drive is different depending upon the options selected when placing the Data Box Disk order. If a precreated folder does not exist, do not create it as copying to a user created folder will fail to upload on Azure. 背景信息 Copy data to disks Take the following steps to copy data for import: Copy the data that needs to be imported as block blobs in to BlockBlob folder. Similarly, copy data such as VHD/VHDX to PageBlob folder and data in to AzureFile folder. When copying files, ensure that files do not exceed ~4.7 TiB for block blobs, ~8 TiB for page blobs, and ~1 TiB for Azure Files. For detailed and updated information of this product, refer to: Copy Data to disks 排查思路 You can use drag and drop with File Explorer to copy the data. You can also use any SMB compatible file copy tool such as Robocopy to copy your data. Multiple copy jobs can be initiated using the following Robocopy command: Robocopy <source <destination /MT:64 /E /R:1 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /FFT /Log:c:\RobocopyLog.txt Check the copy status when the job is in progress. Open the target folder to view and verify the copied files. If you have any errors during the copy process, download the log files for troubleshooting. The log files are located as specified in the robocopy command. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Copy data to disks Take the following steps to copy data for import: View the contents of the unlocked drive. searchText: Doc verification 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box Disk 最近修改: 2022-07-06 14:41:57 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 == Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk FAQ Azure Docs tell it's up to 5 business days. But Cx may not read the FAQ until they met issue. so it is better to mention the estimated SLA in this doc. 问题现象 / 场景 == Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk FAQ Azure Docs tell it's up to 5 business days. But Cx may not read the FAQ until they met issue. so it is better to mention the estimated SLA in this doc. 3. Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk FAQ Azure Docs the FAQ didn't mention how long it will take between disk received at DC and data copy begin. Our testing seems smooths, both began within 2 hours. But Cx do have experience that the copy didn't start after several days? In most situation, that are due to the issue mention above of the shipping label issue. Can we add a FAQ of this common issue? during ops preparing for disks and data importing, when there is issue the progress/status will not change for several days. But from cx view, they only feel the service is slow. So in the future, when having backend issue, can we proactively post some information to cx so they will know the real status? 背景信息 Doc verification Overall Experience: Link Self-Managed Shipment MS-Managed Shipment Both Azure Data Box Disk overview Azure Docs Done Quickstart for Azure Data Box Disk Azure Docs The docs actually provide technical details that customer asked frequently. But some statement are ambiguous. Tutorial to order Azure Data Box Disk Azure Docs 1. The docs for self-managed shipment is not localized: Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk self-managed Shipping Microsoft Docs == I have sent email to azure.cn docs team for localization 1. The department, c/o will not be printed out in the shipping label. It has the possibility that carrier could not find the correct address to deliver. It is better to let cx know which lines in the address table will be printed out in the shipping label so Cx can fill in the information correctly. 1. The default email address in mooncake is not a real mail box. If cx left it as default, Cx will never receive the notification email. It is better to add a reminder here to ask cx to input an valid mail box address. 2. The docs didn't tell how long will need for disk prepare done. During our test, BJB took 1 day, but CE3 took 3 days. Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk self-managed Shipping Microsoft Docs In self-managed mode, the address should not require. But workflow requires information must not be empty here. It is very kind that the notification email provided English/Chinese version. But the address provided in notification email are all English. It is not easy to use English version address to locate in China. Suggest to provide a Chinese version Address. Not applicable Tutorial to unpack, connect to, unlock Azure Data Box Disk Azure Docs 1. It is better to highlight some critical information in the guide or during email notification. For example: the shipping label to return disk. To tell the Cx that if using different tracking id to return disk, it will cause the information mismatch and action delay. We do have customer didn't keep the label and used a new label which cause data copy delay. Tutorial to copy data to Azure Data Box Disk Azure Docs -- per my test, the files under AzureFile will not uploaded as block blobs but will be uploaded to a default fileshare databox-<jobname -<number . The doc didn't provide correct caveats. Tutorial to ship Azure Data Box Disk back Azure Docs The email only contain China East DC, for China north DC, is the contact working? 2. 1. The doc (nor other docs) didn't mention how long will it take between received and data copy. We do had several tickets that cx query why data copy didn't start after several days of received. The docs didn't tell how long will data copy happen after disk received. Even the FAQ didn't provide an estimate SLA. We do have cx reported that copy didn't start after several days. Can we have an estimated SLA so that cx will have correct expectation? And Cx can know how long they should contact support or operation to have an update. NA Azure Data Box Disk security features Azure Docs Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk FAQ Azure Docs Some questions that Cx asks frequently but no answer in FAQ: 1. Microsoft Azure Data Box Disk FAQ Azure Docs the job location is always China East, FAQ has pointed out that. But how Cx can tell where the actual disk prepare location(region)? If cx can choose the preferred disk prepare location(region)? 2. Since there is self-managed shipment, how the price is different with the MSM shipment? Will Cx be charged shipment fee or not? Other observation After going through all the docs and working on different tickets, we found that the docs contain many tech details but not with a clear architecture. The tech details are scattered across different documents. Cx needs to review different docs for a certain question. e.g. the docs of QuickStart, copy data, and limitations mentioned how data will upload to azure, but in different details. Cx may need to read all the 3 docs to have a full understanding about the truth. 排查思路 The section only suggested cx to run validate. But didn't tell what will happen if run or not. Suggest to add more details data import logic: 3. The estimated SLA is up to 5 business day for disk preparation. Cx may not be willing to wait for so long. Can Cx get an option in portal to push the dispatch in case of some urgent situation so backend can priority the order? During communicating with Operation team, I was told that once the disks are ready, Customer will wait 1 ~ 2 working days to let DC apply for security record. Optionally, select Include memory dumps. Then select Create Support package. You shouldn't select the Include memory dumps option unless Support asks for one. It takes a long time to gather a support package that includes memory dumps, and sensitive data is included. After it is created click on "Download" and provide customer with DTM link workspace to upload. Generate from PS (will include later) Analyzing Support packages: References: 排查思路 For all issues, check the following log files: DiagnosticsTestResults,json: Located at the top-level of the support package. Check the test status of each test to determine whether it’s passed or failed. If any test has failed, troubleshooting should start from here. hcsmgmt.Primary: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \hcslogs. Check for any instances of [Err]. 操作步骤 / 命令 Get-HcsApplianceInfo.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the device software version. If the expected version and the version listed in this log are different, an update issue occurred on the device. Get-HcsTimeSettings.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the time zone. If there is a discrepancy between the expected time zone and the time one listed in this log, update the time zone via the local WebUI and try the failed operation once more. If it fails, check the time settings once again and see if the discrepancy still exists. Get-HcsNetInterface.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the ‘State’ of each port. If any ports show status other than ‘Up’, (Or blank, for any ports that are not connected), troubleshooting should start from here. Get-ClusterResource.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the ‘State’ of each resource. searchText: Generating and analyzing support packages 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-21 04:29:23 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Generating support packages: 问题现象 / 场景 Generating support packages: 背景信息 Generating support packages: In the local web UI, go to Contact Support. Optionally, select Include memory dumps. Then select Create Support package. You shouldn't select the Include memory dumps option unless Support asks for one. It takes a long time to gather a support package that includes memory dumps, and sensitive data is included. After it is created click on "Download" and provide customer with DTM link workspace to upload. Generate from PS (will include later) Analyzing Support packages: References: 排查思路 For all issues, check the following log files: DiagnosticsTestResults,json: Located at the top-level of the support package. Check the test status of each test to determine whether it’s passed or failed. If any test has failed, troubleshooting should start from here. hcsmgmt.Primary: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \hcslogs. Check for any instances of [Err]. 操作步骤 / 命令 Get-HcsApplianceInfo.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the device software version. If the expected version and the version listed in this log are different, an update issue occurred on the device. Get-HcsTimeSettings.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the time zone. If there is a discrepancy between the expected time zone and the time one listed in this log, update the time zone via the local WebUI and try the failed operation once more. If it fails, check the time settings once again and see if the discrepancy still exists. Get-HcsNetInterface.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the ‘State’ of each port. If any ports show status other than ‘Up’, (Or blank, for any ports that are not connected), troubleshooting should start from here. Get-ClusterResource.txt: Located at \\<Device Logs \SupportPackage\<Device Name \<Device Serial \cmdlets\PodCmdLets. Check the ‘State’ of each resource. There are some resources that are down by design and should be in an Offline state. These can be ignored. Any resources in a Failed state should be investigated further. 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 Support package video: 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Generating support packages: In the local web UI, go to Contact Support. searchText: Import data to managed disks 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box Disk 最近修改: 2022-04-07 06:25:08 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 If you specified managed disks as one of the storage destinations during order creation, you need to take into consideration the following: 问题现象 / 场景 If you specified managed disks as one of the storage destinations during order creation, you need to take into consideration the following: 背景信息 If you specified managed disks as one of the storage destinations during order creation, you need to take into consideration the following: You can only have one managed disk with a given name in a resource group across all the precreated folders and across all the Data Box Disk. Always copy the VHDs to one of the precreated folders. Split Copy tool is not supported with managed disks. For detailed and updated information of this product, refer to: Copy Data to disks 排查思路 未从原文中明确识别。 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 Only the fixed VHDs can be uploaded to create managed disks. Dynamic VHDs, differencing VHDs or VHDX files are not supported. If you don't have long paths enabled on the client, and any path and file name in your data copy exceeds 256 characters, the Data Box Split Copy Tool (DataBoxDiskSplitCopy.exe) or the Data Box Disk Validation tool (DataBoxDiskValidation.cmd) will report failures. 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） If you specified managed disks as one of the storage destinations during order creation, you need to take into consideration the following: You can only have one managed disk with a given name in a resource group across all the precreated folders and across all the Data Box Disk. title: Importing managed disks using Data Box POD
summary: You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in A
source: VM/Storage/Data Box POD/2022-04-20_Importing managed disks using Data Box POD.md
searchText: Importing managed disks using Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-20 06:55:00 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. The VHDs from on-premises VMs are copied to Data Box as page blobs and are uploaded into Azure as managed disks. These managed disks can then b... 问题现象 / 场景 You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. The VHDs from on-premises VMs are copied to Data Box as page blobs and are uploaded into Azure as managed disks. These managed disks can then be attached to Azure VMs. 背景信息 You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. The VHDs from on-premises VMs are copied to Data Box as page blobs and are uploaded into Azure as managed disks. These managed disks can then be attached to Azure VMs. Based on the resource groups specified, Data Box creates one share for each associated resource group. For example, if mydbmdrg1 and mydbmdrg2 were created when placing the order, the following shares are created: mydbmdrg1 MDisk mydbmdrg2 Mdisk Within each share, the following three folders are created which correspond to containers in your storage account. Premium SSD Standard HDD Standard SSD The following table shows the UNC paths to the shares on your Data Box. UNC path to the share SMB \\<DeviceIPAddress \<ResourceGroupName MDisk \<PremiumSSD \file1.vhd \\<DeviceIPAddress \<ResourceGroupName MDisk \<StandardHDD \file2.vhd \\<DeviceIPAddress \<ResourceGroupName MDisk \<StandardSSD \file3.vhd NFS //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroup1 MDisk /<PremiumSSD /file1.vhd //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /<StandardHDD /file2.vhd //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /<StandardSSD /file3.vhd You will need to use either SMB or NFS to connect to the Data Box shares and upload VHDs. Connecting via REST APIs is not supported for the managed disk import feature of Data Box. Review the following considerations before you begin data copy: Always copy the VHDs to one of the precreated folders. If you copy the VHDs outside of these folders or in a folder that you created, the VHDs will be uploaded to Azure Storage account as page blobs and not managed disks. You can only have one managed disk with a given name in a resource group across all of the precreated folders. This implies that the VHDs uploaded to the precreated folders should have unique names. Make sure that the given name does not match an already existing managed disk in a resource group. Review managed disk limits in Azure object size limits. For more information on importing VHD files to managed disks using Data Box, please see the link below. Use Data Box to import data as managed disks in Azure 排查思路 If there are errors during the copy process, download the logs from the Connect and copy page. If you copied a file that is not 512 bytes aligned, the file isn't uploaded as page blob to your staging storage account. You will see an error in the logs. Remove the file and copy a file that is 512 bytes aligned. If you copied a VHDX (these files are not supported) with a long name, you will see errors in the logs similar to those shown below. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 Connection protocol 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 Only fixed size VHDs can be uploaded to create managed disks. VHDX files or dynamic and differencing VHDs are not supported. 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） You can use the Data Box device to import VHD files from on-premises VMs for conversion into managed disks in Azure. searchText: July 8, 2025—KB5062553 (OS Build 26100.4652)导致windows无法启动 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2025-08-15 10:28:10 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 这个KB有一个已知issue：二代虚拟机，如果不是受信任启动，会造成windows无法启动故障 问题现象 / 场景 这个KB有一个已知issue：二代虚拟机，如果不是受信任启动，会造成windows无法启动故障 背景信息 【问题背景】 【问题分析】 关于这个KB的说明：July 8, 2025—KB5062553 (OS Build 26100.4652) - Microsoft Support 我测试，可以复现这个问题，和镜像没有关系，和从磁盘创建虚拟机有关系。 关于客户关心的成本问题，文档中明确写了：受信任启动无需额外成本。 排查思路 客户陆续接到很多同事的报告，大量Azure VM无法启动，经过两个多小时的排查，最终确认，无法启动的VM安装了【2025 年 7 月 8 日 - KB5062553（OS 内部版本 26100.4652）】 操作步骤 / 命令 对于这个情况，通过命令行（azure cli）可以完成这个变更，估计是portal的api接口有问题 命令示例：az vm update --resource-group xxxx --name xxxx --security-type TrustedLaunch 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 【解决方案】 将虚拟机安全类型配置为“受信任启动”，对于安装了KB5062553，windows可以正常启动。 客户有一些机器是自定义镜像，通过磁盘创建的，磁盘的安全类型是标准，将虚拟机安全类型配置为“受信任启动”这个选项是灰色的，提示：“Security type cannot be updated with the current image.” 参考链接 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 【问题背景】 客户陆续接到很多同事的报告，大量Azure VM无法启动，经过两个多小时的排查，最终确认，无法启动的VM安装了【2025 年 7 月 8 日 - KB5062553（OS 内部版本 26100.4652）】 【问题分析】 关于这个KB的说明：July 8, 2025—KB5062553 (OS Build 26100.4652) - Microsoft Support 这个KB有一个已知issue：二代虚拟机，如果不是受信任启动，会造成windows无法启动故障 【解决方案】 将虚拟机安全类型配置为“受信任启动”，对于安装了KB5062553，windows可以正常启动。 客户有一些机器是自定义镜像，通过磁盘创建的，磁盘的安全类型是标准，将虚拟机安全类型配置为“受信任启动”这个选项是灰色的，提示：“Security type cannot be updated with the current image.” 我测试，可以复现这个问题，和镜像没有关系，和从磁盘创建虚拟机有关系。 对于这个情况，通过命令行（azure cli）可以完成这个变更，估计是portal的api接口有问题 命令示例：az vm update --resource-group xxxx --name xxxx --security-type TrustedLaunch 关于客户关心的成本问题，文档中明确写了：受信任启动无需额外成本。

source: VM/Storage/KB/2024-05-31_LVM挂载以及克隆.md
searchText: LVM挂载以及克隆 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-05-31 13:46:52 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 注：如果w保存后有报错，例如下面的 问题现象 / 场景 注：如果w保存后有报错，例如下面的 如果执行后，仍然报错，重启解决。 背景信息 LVM的结构 如何为LV、VG扩容： 如果LV空间不足，需要扩容，可以看看对应的VG是否还有一定的空间大小，如果有，可以扩容。 VG同理 LVM创建 分区 通过fdisk /dev/sdc进行分区。 n：创建一个新的扩展分区（e：extended）， 对已扩展的分区，创建逻辑分区。 t ： 修改分区类型为Linux LVM 已改，w保存退出。 PV 通过pvcreate /dev/sdc5 /dev/sdc6 /dev/sdc7创建pv VG 通过vgcreate vgdemo /dev/sdc5 /dev/sdc6创建vg LV 通过lvcreate -n lv1 -L +30M vgdemo创建lv 格式化 mkfs.ext4 /dev/vgdemo/lv1 挂载 如果使用LVM合并、使用uuid挂载磁盘，在克隆出新的虚拟机的时候（仅os磁盘），需要先umount，再修改/etc/fstab。 如果只修改/etc/fstab，是仍然起不来的。 排查思路 首先通过lsblk查看所有块设备的信息。 p：查看当前的分区状态。 通过vgs查看简略信息 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 解决方法：执行：partprobe /dev/sdc 自动挂载：修改/etc/fstab ，可以通过device name、UUID 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） 2023-12-07 LVM的结构 如何为LV、VG扩容： 如果LV空间不足，需要扩容，可以看看对应的VG是否还有一定的空间大小，如果有，可以扩容。 VG同理 LVM创建 分区 首先通过lsblk查看所有块设备的信息。 通过fdisk /dev/sdc进行分区。 p：查看当前的分区状态。 n：创建一个新的扩展分区（e：extended）， 对已扩展的分区，创建逻辑分区。 t ： 修改分区类型为Linux LVM 已改，w保存退出。 注：如果w保存后有报错，例如下面的 解决方法：执行：partprobe /dev/sdc 如果执行后，仍然报错，重启解决。 PV 通过pvcreate /dev/sdc5 /dev/sdc6 /dev/sdc7创建pv VG 通过vgcreate vgdemo /dev/sdc5 /dev/sdc6创建vg 通过vgs查看简略信息 LV 通过lvcreate -n lv1 -L +30M vgdemo创建lv 格式化 mkfs.ext4 /dev/vgdemo/lv1 挂载 自动挂载：修改/etc/fstab ，可以通过device name、UUID 如果使用LVM合并、使用uuid挂载磁盘，在克隆出新的虚拟机的时候（仅os磁盘），需要先umount，再修改/etc/fstab。 如果只修改/etc/fstab，是仍然起不来的。

Once the device arrives at the customer's location and they connect it to their network, the customer will access the local web UI to configure the network ports in the device and obtain credentials for accessing the shares to copy data to or from the device. 背景信息 For import orders, the customer will run Prepare to Ship through the local web UI after copying their data onto the device, then they will ship the device back to the Azure data center. For export orders, after the customer has copied the exported data off of the Data Box shares, they can delete their data from the Data Box device and then ship the device back to the Azure data center. searchText: Ordering a Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-06 07:08:25 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 To create a Data Box order, customers must have an Azure subscription of the type MCA (Microsoft Customer Agreement), EA (Enterprise Agreement), CSP (Cloud Solution Provider), MPN (Microsoft Partner Network), or Microsoft Azure Sponsorship. 问题现象 / 场景 To create a Data Box order, customers must have an Azure subscription of the type MCA (Microsoft Customer Agreement), EA (Enterprise Agreement), CSP (Cloud Solution Provider), MPN (Microsoft Partner Network), or Microsoft Azure Sponsorship. 背景信息 Order Azure Data Box for Import Order Azure Data Box for Export Microsoft Stream 排查思路 In most cases the customer will want to create a Data Box order through the Azure portal. To do this, they will sign into the Azure portal, select "Create a resource", search for "Azure Data Box", and then click "Create". The customer can then select either the "Import to Azure" or "Export from Azure" transfer type, choose the type of device to order (Data Box device, Data Box Heavy, or Data Box Disk), and set other options such as Azure subscription, resource group, and the storage account(s) to import data to or export data from. The customer can either choose to use the default security settings for Data Box, or they can choose to set up their own encryption keys and passwords. After the customer enters their shipping address and submits the order, they will be able to track the order status through the Azure portal. If they need to cancel an order, they can do so as long as the order has not yet reached the "Processed" status. Further information on ordering Data Box devices through the Azure portal can be found at the links below. 操作步骤 / 命令 It is also possible to order Data Box devices and track order status using the Azure CLI or Azure PowerShell. Some customers who have a need to create large numbers of Data Box orders may choose to use one of these methods so that they can manage the ordering process using scripts instead of the Azure portal UI. For more information on ordering a Data Box using the Azure CLI, please see this link: Order Data Box for Import - Azure CLI. title: Running Prepare to Ship and returning the Data Box
summary: This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with A
source: VM/Storage/Data Box POD/2022-04-20_Running Prepare to Ship and returning the Data Box.md
searchText: Running Prepare to Ship and returning the Data Box 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-20 07:18:00 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with Azure storage requirements and limits. 问题现象 / 场景 This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with Azure storage requirements and limits. After the Prepare to Ship process completes without errors, the customer can proceed with shipping the Data Box back to the Azure datacenter for data import. The steps for return shipping of a Data Box device vary by country. More information on return shipping can be found at this link: Ship Data Box back. 背景信息 To start Prepare to Ship, in the device web UI, go to Prepare to Ship and click on "Start Preparation". During the Prepare to Ship process, the Data Box shares will be taken offline and will not be accessible. Please ensure that all data to be imported is copied onto the shares prior to running Prepare to Ship. If there is more data that needs to be copied to the device, you can stop Prepare to Ship, unlock the device, copy the additional data, and then run Prepare to Ship again. The length of time required for Prepare to Ship to run depends on the amount of data the customer has written to the Data Box and the number of individual files and blobs. Prepare to Ship may take anywhere from a few hours for smaller data sets to several days for data sets containing many millions of files and/or blobs. Microsoft Stream 排查思路 When using Data Box to import data into Azure, before return shipping the device back to the Azure datacenter, the customer must run the Prepare to Ship process. This process validates the data by: Ensuring that checksums are generated for all files Checking that all data conforms to Azure naming conventions Checking that files and blobs are not too large for Azure storage file / blob size limits Checking that all container and share names conform to Azure naming conventions For more information on Prepare to Ship and the return shipping process, please see this link: Return Azure Data Box and verify data upload to Azure. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 If Prepare to Ship completes with the status "Scan completed with errors", the customer should resolve these errors before returning the device. To see what errors have occurred, unlock the device and go to the Connect and Copy page to download the issues list. Information on how to correct issues identified by Prepare to Ship can be found in the Troubleshooting Prepare to Ship page of this OneNote. After correcting these issues, the customer will need to run Prepare to Ship again to validate that all errors have been resolved. 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） When using Data Box to import data into Azure, before return shipping the device back to the Azure datacenter, the customer must run the Prepare to Ship process. This process validates the data by: Ensuring that checksums are generated for all files Checking that all data conforms to Azure naming conventions Checking that files and blobs are not too large for Azure storage file / blob size limits Checking that all container and share names conform to Azure naming conventions This process is required to prevent potential data upload failures due to data that does not conform with Azure storage requirements and limits. To start Prepare to Ship, in the device web UI, go to Prepare to Ship and click on "Start Preparation". During the Prepare to Ship process, the Data Box shares will be taken offline and will not be accessible. Please ensure that all data to be imported is copied onto the shares prior to running Prepare to Ship. If there is more data that needs to be copied to the device, you can stop Prepare to Ship, unlock the device, copy the additional data, and then run Prepare to Ship again. The length of time required for Prepare to Ship to run depends on the amount of data the customer has written to the Data Box and the number of individual files and blobs. Prepare to Ship may take anywhere from a few hours for smaller data sets to several days for data sets containing many millions of files and/or blobs. If Prepare to Ship completes with the status "Scan completed with errors", the customer should resolve these errors before returning the device. To see what errors have occurred, unlock the device and go to the Connect and Copy page to download the issues list. Information on how to correct issues identified by Prepare to Ship can be found in the Troubleshooting Prepare to Ship page of this OneNote. After correcting these issues, the customer will need to run Prepare to Ship again to validate that all errors have been resolved. After the Prepare to Ship process completes without errors, the customer can proceed with shipping the Data Box back to the Azure datacenter for data import. The steps for return shipping of a Data Box device vary by country. More information on return shipping can be found at this link: Ship Data Box back. For more information on Prepare to Ship and the return shipping process, please see this link: Return Azure Data Box and verify data upload to Azure. Microsoft Stream

This service can also be used to transfer data from Azure Blob storage to disk drives and ship to your on-premises sites. Data from one or more disk drives can be imported either to Azure Blob storage or Azure Files. 背景信息 Azure Import/Export service is used to securely import large amounts of data to Azure Blob storage and Azure Files by shipping disk drives to an Azure datacenter. This service can also be used to transfer data from Azure Blob storage to disk drives and ship to your on-premises sites. Data from one or more disk drives can be imported either to Azure Blob storage or Azure Files. Supply your own disk drives and transfer data with the Azure Import/Export service. You can also use disk drives supplied by Microsoft. Import/Export components Import/Export service WAImportExport tool Disk Drives How does Import/Export work Inside an import job Inside an export job Region availability The Azure Import/Export service supports copying data to and from all Azure storage accounts. You can ship disk drives to one of the listed locations. If your storage account is in an Azure location that is not specified here, an alternate shipping location is provided when you create the job. Security considerations The data on the drive is encrypted using AES 256-bit BitLocker Drive Encryption. This encryption protects your data while it is in transit. For import jobs, drives are encrypted in two ways. Specify the option when using dataset.csv file while running the WAImportExport tool during drive preparation. Deleting personal information Personal contact information may be deleted in the following ways: Data saved with the job is deleted with the job. Users can delete jobs manually and completed jobs are automatically deleted after 90 days. source: VM/Storage/Data Box POD/2022-04-01_Use cases for Data Box POD.md
searchText: Use cases for Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-01 05:45:51 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Use cases 问题现象 / 场景 Use cases 背景信息 Use cases Data Box is ideally suited to transfer data sizes larger than 40 TBs in scenarios with no to limited network connectivity. The data movement can be one-time, periodic, or an initial bulk data transfer followed by periodic transfers. Here are the various scenarios where Data Box can be used to import data to Azure. Onetime migration - when a large amount of on-premises data is moved to Azure. Moving a media library from offline tapes into Azure to create an online media library. Migrating your VM farm, SQL server, and applications to Azure. Moving historical data to Azure for in-depth analysis and reporting using HDInsight. Initial bulk transfer - when an initial bulk transfer is done using Data Box (seed) followed by incremental transfers over the network. Periodic uploads - when large amount of data is generated periodically and needs to be moved to Azure. For example in energy exploration, where video content is generated on oil rigs and windmill farms. Here are the various scenarios where Data Box can be used to export data from Azure. Disaster recovery - when a copy of the data from Azure is restored to an on-premises network. In a typical disaster recovery scenario, a large amount of Azure data is exported to a Data Box. Microsoft then ships this Data Box, and the data is restored on your premises in a short time. Security requirements - when you need to be able to export data out of Azure due to government or security requirements. For example, Azure Storage is available in US Secret and Top Secret clouds, and you can use Data Box to export data out of Azure. Migrate back to on-premises or to another cloud service provider - when you want to move all the data back to on-premises, or to another cloud service provider, export data via Data Box to migrate the workloads. title: Using NFS shares on Data Box POD
summary: The NFS shares on a Data Box device have a naming convention based on the storage account(s) that data is being imported to or exported from and the type of data being imported or exported. The syntax for the UNC path to each share is shown below.
source: VM/Storage/Data Box POD/2022-04-15_Using NFS shares on Data Box POD.md
searchText: Using NFS shares on Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-15 05:54:31 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 The NFS shares on a Data Box device have a naming convention based on the storage account(s) that data is being imported to or exported from and the type of data being imported or exported. The syntax for the UNC path to each share is shown below. 问题现象 / 场景 The NFS shares on a Data Box device have a naming convention based on the storage account(s) that data is being imported to or exported from and the type of data being imported or exported. The syntax for the UNC path to each share is shown below. 背景信息 The NFS shares on a Data Box device have a naming convention based on the storage account(s) that data is being imported to or exported from and the type of data being imported or exported. The syntax for the UNC path to each share is shown below. Azure Block blob - //<device IP address /<storage account name BlockBlob Azure Page blob - //<device IP address /<storage account name \ PageBlob Azure Files - //<device IP address /<storage account name AzFile Azure Block blob (Archive) - //<device IP address /<storage account name BlockBlobArchive If a Data Box device is being used to import to managed disks, the device will have additional shares with a naming convention based on the resource group selected during the ordering process and the type of managed disk that will be created upon data import. The syntax for these share names is shown below. Premium SSD - //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /PremiumSSD Standard HDD - //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /StandardHDD Standard SSD - //<DeviceIPAddress /<ResourceGroupName MDisk /StandardSSD The basic steps to connect to an NFS share on the Data Box device from a Linux or Mac OS client are: In the local web UI on the device, go to the "Connect and copy" page. Under "NFS settings", click "NFS client access". Enter the IP address of the NFS client and click "Add". You can configure access for up to 5 NFS clients / IP addresses by repeating this step. When all the IP addresses you want to add have been entered, click OK. For Linux clients, use the following command syntax to mount the NFS share: sudo mount <Data Box device IP :/<NFS share on Data Box device <Path to the folder on local Linux computer For Mac clients, use the following command syntax to mount the NFS share: sudo mount -t nfs -o sec=sys,resvport 10.161.23.130:/Mystoracct Blob /home/databoxubuntuhost/databox The recommended command line copy tool to use with Data Box from a Linux system is rsync. For more information on using NFS with a Data Box device, please see the links below. title: Using REST APIs with Data Box POD
summary: Customers can use the REST APIs to connect to a Data Box device over HTTP or HTTPS and copy blob data for import to A

searchText: Using REST APIs with Data Box POD 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-15 06:24:42 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Customers can use the REST APIs to connect to a Data Box device over HTTP or HTTPS and copy blob data for import to Azure blob storage using Azure Storage Explorer, AzCopy, or a similar copy tool. The basic steps for connecting to the Data Box via REST using A... 问题现象 / 场景 Customers can use the REST APIs to connect to a Data Box device over HTTP or HTTPS and copy blob data for import to Azure blob storage using Azure Storage Explorer, AzCopy, or a similar copy tool. The basic steps for connecting to the Data Box via REST using Azure Storage Explorer from a Windows PC are: 背景信息 Customers can use the REST APIs to connect to a Data Box device over HTTP or HTTPS and copy blob data for import to Azure blob storage using Azure Storage Explorer, AzCopy, or a similar copy tool. The basic steps for connecting to the Data Box via REST using Azure Storage Explorer from a Windows PC are: In the Data Box local web UI under "Connect and copy", click on the REST button. Copy the information under Storage Account Name, Storage Account Key, and Blob Service Endpoint. On the Windows PC, open the file C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts in Notepad. In the hosts file, add a line containing the Data Box device IP address and the blob service endpoint obtained from the Data Box web UI, then save the hosts file. See reference image below. After performing these steps, in Storage Explorer you can expand the Data Box storage account and create new containers under Blob Containers, then copy data into these containers in order to import it into Azure blob storage. For more information on using the REST APIs with Data Box devices, including information on using AzCopy with Data Box and on connecting via REST from a Linux client, please see the link below. Use REST APIs to copy data to Azure Data Box blob storage 排查思路 If using HTTPS to connect to the Data Box, you will need to download a certificate from the Data Box job in the Azure portal and import it on the Windows client. To do this, go to the Data Box order information in the Azure portal, navigate to General - Device Details, and under Device Credentials click on the API Access tab. Then click the Download button to download the certificate. Once it is downloaded, you can right-click on the certificate and select "Install certificate". In the Certificate Import Wizard, choose Local Machine as the Store Location and place the certificate in the store named "Trusted Root Certification Authorities". Click Next and then Finish to install the certificate. In Azure Storage Explorer, go to the Edit menu and click on Target Azure Stack. After changing this setting, clost and reopen Storage Explorer. Then open the Connect to Azure Storage dialog and choose the option for "Use a storage account name and key". On the next page, enter the storage account name, storage account key, and for the storage domain enter "mydataboxno.microsoftdatabox.com". If using HTTP, check the box for "Use HTTP", or to use HTTPS leave this box unchecked. Click Next and then Connect to finish connecting to blob storage on the Data Box. 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 未从原文中明确识别。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Customers can use the REST APIs to connect to a Data Box device over HTTP or HTTPS and copy blob data for import to Azure blob storage using Azure Storage Explorer, AzCopy, or a similar copy tool. title: Using the Data Copy Service
source: VM/Storage/Data Box POD/2022-04-20_Using the Data Copy Service.md
searchText: Using the Data Copy Service 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: Storage Section: Data Box POD 最近修改: 2022-04-20 06:45:41 JD 相关性: 迁移/实施; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 Failed 问题现象 / 场景 Failed Completed with errors You can run up to 10 data copy service jobs concurrently to copy data from different SMB shares onto the Data Box. You can create unlimited numbers of jobs, but only 10 can be running at once. After all copy jobs is finished, you can select Prepare to Ship. The Prepare to Ship process cannot be run while a data copy service job is still in progress. 背景信息 The data copy service is a service that can be configured in the Data Box device web UI to bring data from network shares onto the Data Box for import into Azure storage. This service runs locally on Microsoft Azure Data Box, connects to a network-attached storage (NAS) device or network share via SMB, and copies data onto the Data Box. It is best to use the data copy service in the following circumstances: In NAS environments where intermediate hosts might not be available. With small files that take weeks for ingestion and upload of data. The data copy service significantly improves the ingestion and upload time for small files. To copy data by using the data copy service, you need to create a job using the following steps: In the local web UI of your Data Box device, go to Manage Copy data. On the Copy data page, select Create. Field Value Job name A unique name fewer than 230 characters for the job. These characters aren't allowed in the job name: <, , , ?, , \, :, /, and \. Source location Provide the SMB path to the data source in the format: \\<ServerIPAddress \<ShareName or \\<ServerName \<ShareName . Username Username in \\<DomainName <UserName format to access the data source. If a local administrator is connecting, they will need explicit security permissions. Right-click the folder, select Properties and then select Security. This should add the local administrator in the Security tab. Password Password to access the data source. Destination storage account Destination type Destination container/share Enter the name of the container or share that you want to upload data to in your destination storage account. The name can be a share name or a container name. For example, use myshare or mycontainer. You can also enter the name in the format sharename\directory name or containername\virtual directory name. Copy files matching pattern You can enter the file-name matching pattern in the following two ways: Use wildcard expressions: Only and ? are supported in wildcard expressions. For example, the expression .vhd matches all the files that have the .vhd extension. Similarly, .dl? matches all the files with either the extension .dl or that start with .dl, such as .dll. Likewise, foo matches all the files whose names end with foo. You can directly enter the wildcard expression in the field. By default, the value you enter in the field is treated as a wildcard expression. Use regular expressions: POSIX-based regular expressions are supported. For example, the regular expression . \.vhd will match all the files that have the .vhd extension. For regular expressions, provide the <pattern directly as regex(<pattern ). For more information about regular expressions, go to Regular expression language - a quick reference. File optimization If you use file optimization: After you run prepare to ship, you can download a BOM file, which lists the original file names, to help you ensure that all the right files are copied. Don't delete the packed files, whose file names begin with "ADB PACK ". If you delete a packed file, the original file isn't uploaded during future data copies. File optimization is not supported for Azure Files. To see what timestamps, file attributes, and ACLs are copied for a non-optimized data copy job, view the transferred metadata. You can pause a job if it's affecting the NAS device's resources during peak hours: You can resume the job later during off-peak hours: You can cancel a job at any time: When you cancel a job, a confirmation is required: If you decide to cancel a job, the data that is already copied isn't deleted. The simplest method to delete any data that you've copied to your Data Box device is to reset the device. While the job is in progress, on the Copy data page in the Status column, you can view the status of the copy job. The status can be: Running Succeeded Pausing Paused Canceling Canceled For more information on the data copy service, please see the link below. Use the data copy service to copy data into Azure Data Box (preview) 排查思路 In the Configure job and start dialog box, fill out the following fields: A job with the specified settings is created. You can pause, resume, cancel, or restart a job. Select the check box next to the job name, and then select the appropriate button. In the Files column, you can see the number and the total size of the files being copied. In the Processed column, you can see the number and the total size of the files that are processed. In the Job details column, select View to see the job details. If any errors occur during the copy process, as shown in the Errors column, go to the Error log column and download the error logs for troubleshooting. 操作步骤 / 命令 Select the target storage account to upload data to from the list. Select the target storage type from the list: Block Blob, Page Blob, Azure Files, or Block Blob (Archive). Select Start. The inputs are validated, and if the validation succeeds, then the job starts. It might take a few minutes for the job to start. 关键参数 / 状态码 Don't copy the same files that you copy with the Copy Service via other protocols such as SMB, NFS, or REST API. Using different protocols can result in conflicts and failure during data uploads. 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 When this feature is enabled, files smaller than 1 MB are packed during ingestion. In the Processed column, you can see the number and the total size of the files that are processed. In the Job details column, select View to see the job details. Source location Provide the SMB path to the data source in the format: \\<ServerIPAddress \<ShareName or \\<ServerName \<ShareName . Username Username in \\<DomainName <UserName format to access the data source. If a local administrator is connecting, they will need explicit security permissions. Right-click the folder, select Properties and then select Security. This should add the local administrator in the Security tab. Password Password to access the data source. Destination storage account Select the target storage account to upload data to from the list. Destination type Select the target storage type from the list: Block Blob, Page Blob, Azure Files, or Block Blob (Archive). Destination container/share Enter the name of the container or share that you want to upload data to in your destination storage account. The name can be a share name or a container name. For example, use myshare or mycontainer. You can also enter the name in the format sharename\directory name or containername\virtual directory name. Copy files matching pattern You can enter the file-name matching pattern in the following two ways: Use wildcard expressions: Only and ? are supported in wildcard expressions. For example, the expression .vhd matches all the files that have the .vhd extension. Similarly, .dl? matches all the files with either the extension .dl or that start with .dl, such as .dll. Likewise, foo matches all the files whose names end with foo. You can directly enter the wildcard expression in the field. By default, the value you enter in the field is treated as a wildcard expression. Use regular expressions: POSIX-based regular expressions are supported. For example, the regular expression . \.vhd will match all the files that have the .vhd extension. For regular expressions, provide the <pattern directly as regex(<pattern ). For more information about regular expressions, go to Regular expression language - a quick reference. File optimization When this feature is enabled, files smaller than 1 MB are packed during ingestion. This packing speeds up the data copy for small files. It also saves a significant amount of time when the number of files far exceeds the number of directories. If you use file optimization: After you run prepare to ship, you can download a BOM file, which lists the original file names, to help you ensure that all the right files are copied. Don't delete the packed files, whose file names begin with "ADB PACK ". If you delete a packed file, the original file isn't uploaded during future data copies. Don't copy the same files that you copy with the Copy Service via other protocols such as SMB, NFS, or REST API. Using different protocols can result in conflicts and failure during data uploads. File optimization is not supported for Azure Files. To see what timestamps, file attributes, and ACLs are copied for a non-optimized data copy job, view the transferred metadata. Select Start. The inputs are validated, and if the validation succeeds, then the job starts. It might take a few minutes for the job to start. A job with the specified settings is created. You can pause, resume, cancel, or restart a job. Select the check box next to the job name, and then select the appropriate button. You can pause a job if it's affecting the NAS device's resources during peak hours: You can resume the job later during off-peak hours: You can cancel a job at any time: When you cancel a job, a confirmation is required: If you decide to cancel a job, the data that is already copied isn't deleted. The simplest method to delete any data that you've copied to your Data Box device is to reset the device. While the job is in progress, on the Copy data page in the Status column, you can view the status of the copy job. The status can be: Running Failed Succeeded Pausing Paused Canceling Canceled Completed with errors In the Files column, you can see the number and the total size of the files being copied. In the Processed column, you can see the number and the total size of the files that are processed. In the Job details column, select View to see the job details. If any errors occur during the copy process, as shown in the Errors column, go to the Error log column and download the error logs for troubleshooting. You can run up to 10 data copy service jobs concurrently to copy data from different SMB shares onto the Data Box. You can create unlimited numbers of jobs, but only 10 can be running at once. After all copy jobs is finished, you can select Prepare to Ship. The Prepare to Ship process cannot be run while a data copy service job is still in progress. For more information on the data copy service, please see the link below. Use the data copy service to copy data into Azure Data Box (preview)

The copy will complete in one of two ways: Data Copy to Azure at the Datacenter (For Support) Lens is an extremely useful tool that can be used to view details on an Azure Data Box job, such as device details, job and copy status, as well as information on tracking and relevant IcMs. Causes for Data Copy to Azure Slow or Stalled Copy If no IcMs exist for the Data Box job in question, raise an IcM with the XTDataPathTeam for assistance. 排查思路 Order status Completed — All of the data was ingested successfully, and the data copy percentage is 100%. The copy logs will be available for the customer to review and cross-verify their data in a separate container of the storage account the Data Box job was associated with. Order status Completed with errors — Some amount of data was not copied to Azure (could be 1% or 99%; 1 file, or multiple files). In most cases, when data fails to copy to Azure, the customer is not charged. Especially when the failure is the fault of Microsoft (i.e., hardware or software issue on our end). Customers can be charged if the failure of the copy is identified to be the fault of the customer in some way. The copy logs, including the verbose and error logs will be available for the customer to review and cross-verify their data in a separate container of the storage account the Data Box job was associated with. For detailed and updated information, go to: Troubleshoot data copy issues If a customer notices that the data copy to Azure has slowed or stalled completely, verify using Lens or ASC. In most cases, when data fails to copy to Azure, the customer is not charged. Especially when the failure is the fault of Microsoft (i.e., hardware or software issue on our end). Customers can be charged if the failure of the copy is identified to be the fault of the customer in some way. The copy logs, including the verbose and error logs will be available for the customer to review and cross-verify their data in a separate container of the storage account the Data Box job was associated with. Data Copy to Azure at the Datacenter (For Support) Lens and ASC Lens is an extremely useful tool that can be used to view details on an Azure Data Box job, such as device details, job and copy status, as well as information on tracking and relevant IcMs. For detailed and updated information, go to: Data Box Lens Dashboard (Note: These operations can also be done in ASC) Causes for Data Copy to Azure Errors that occur during a copy job to Azure are generally caused by the customer ignoring errors and warnings shown during Prepare to Ship, or skipping Prepare to Ship entirely. When errors occur during the data copy to Azure, customers can review the copy logs to see how and why the data failed to copy. The copy logs also provide a summary of the job. For detailed and updated information, go to: Troubleshoot data copy issues Slow or Stalled Copy If a customer notices that the data copy to Azure has slowed or stalled completely, verify using Lens or ASC. Once verified, do the following: Check Lens or ASC for any relevant IcMs that might have been opened automatically. If no IcMs exist for the Data Box job in question, raise an IcM with the XTDataPathTeam for assistance.

动态端口分配的应用程序都使用端口 5000 到 5100（含 5000 和 5100）。在大多数环境中，至少应该打开 100 个端口，因为多个系统服务都依赖于这些 RPC 端口来互相通信。 2). VAMT里的授权状态。 Status Unknown – 显示VAMT没有收集或无法收集到的产品授权状态. Licensed – 显示所有已通过有效的产品密钥激活的产品. Not Licensed – 这是所有产品的需要状态为没有需要的父节点: Out-of-Box (OOB) Grace – 显示所有的产品仍在最初的宽限期. Non-Genuine Grace – 仅适用与Vista. 表示系统已在30天的宽限期内在线验证失败. Out of Tolerance (OOT) Grace – 显示所有产品的硬件或BIOS的变化，从而需要重新激活，并且所有的KMS客户端在180天内没有重新激活. Unlicensed – 激活状态不确定. 这可能是篡改了与激活相关的二进制文件和配置。仅适用于Windows Vista的RTM版及零售版的Office 2010. Notification – 显示左右产品要么是过去的激活宽限期或验证失败。这些产品降接收到通知，但继续以全部功能来运行。 Unmanaged Products – 显示所有已发现的产品不被VAMT支持及管理。这只包括Windows XP SP2及更高版本，或Windows Server 2003 SP1及更高版本。 3). KMS客户端手动激活并查看激活状态 A. 手动激活，可以使用slmgr –ato来自动连接到KMS服务器做激活。 B. 在本机上查看激活状态，可以使用 slmgr –dlv来查看详细的信息。 C. 手动刷新DNS信息，可以使用ipconfig /flushdns来刷新DNS纪录，使用ipconfig /registerdns来重新注册DNS纪录。 D. 对于有些客户端无法注册DNS，可以创建一个批处理文件，并在组策略管理器里的计算机配置里添加到启动里。当计算机启动的时候，会运行这个批处理文件。

(a)在一台客户端机器上访问VIP登录MySQL（请提前在DB1和DB2上做好授权，创建好用户并允许远程登录），客户端的IP是192.168.3.6，执行操作如下 mysql -uroot -p -h 192.168.3.100 show variables like "%hostname"; show variables like "%server id%"; 从输出结果看，此时访问的是DB1 接着上面的SQL操作来测试数据复制功能，执行如下的命令去创建数据库，创建表并插入数据 create database repldb; use repldb; create table repl table(id int,email varchar(100), pasword varchar(100) not null); insert into repl table (id, email, pasword) values( 1, "test@123.com","testpass"); 以上过程创建了一个数据库repldb,创建了一张表repl table并插入数据 登录到DB2这台主机的MySQL，然后查看数据是否同步过来，从输出可以看出，DB1的数据已经完全同步过来，说明数据复制成功。 再来测试一下DB2到DB1的数据同步，保持VIP登录的终端和DB2终端不关闭，同理在DB2 的终端中创建数据库和表并插入数据 create database repldb 2; use repldb 2; create table repl table 2(id int,email varchar(100), password varchar(100) not null); insert into repl table 2 (id, email, password) values( 1, "test@123.com","testpass"); 然后在VIP登录的终端中可以看到在DB2上创建的数据 至此测试MySQL的主从同步功能正常。 （2）测试Keepalived实现MySQL故障转移 为了实现Keepalived的故障转移功能，需要模拟一些故障，这里使用关闭DB1主机MYSQL主从复制功能来模拟故障，由于在Keepalived的监控脚本中都添加了对MySQL复制功能检测的脚本，因此当关闭DB1主机的复制功能后，keepalived会立即检测到并执行切换操作。测试过程如下： （a）首先在客户端上使用VIP登录MySQL，默认情况是访问的DB1 （2）保持使用VIP登录的连接，然后在DB1主机上使用mysql命令行登录，执行slave stop关闭DB1的从复制。 (3)立即在VIP登录的终端中执行查询，由于已经发生切换，所以查询已经无法响应 此时另起一个连接重连，可以快速连接上，可以看到此时切换到了DB2 原有的VIP登录终端需要等待mysql客户端重试查询，获取不到查询结果后超时，该过程对mysql客户端来说时间需要十几分钟，然后重新发起查询，mysql客户端重连后可以得到数据，且可以看到重连后的服务器是DB2，该过程时间较长。 对于已经存在的连接，所以建议在客户端获取不到query结果时，能够快速发起重连，减少等待时间。这在应用层还是比较好实现的。 用paping在整个过程中对VIP的3306端口进行监控，可以看到整个过程中只丢了5个包 这说明Keepalived的切换过程还是很快的，大概只需要5s左右就切换了（需要结合考虑LB探测为Down的时间）。 在DB2上查看，VIP已经转移到DB2，而且DB2 已经是master了。

searchText: 在虚拟机页面搜索提示报错 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: VM Operations Section: KB 最近修改: 2023-03-21 13:40:22 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 网络; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 问题现象： 问题现象 / 场景 问题现象： 客户在虚拟机页面搜索虚拟机时会提示以下报错。 报错信息： An error occured when trying to fetch resources. Additional details from the underlying API that might be helpful: Please provide below info when asking for support: timestamp = 2022-12-06T00:56:56.0805411Z, correlationId = ac4c08ee-6ebc-4480-ba41-c0e698486334. (Code: BadRequest) Query is invalid. Please refer to the documentation for the Azure Resource Graph service and fix the error before retrying. (Code: InvalidQuery) The query has 129 path expression, which exceeds the limit of 128. A path expression is a object accessor, e.g., properties['foo']. (Code: TooManyPathExpressions) 背景信息 Liu Huan Zhang Lihong Update 问题原因： 通过管理视图à编辑列删除掉多于128的N列后，可以正常搜索。 更多信息： 发现是由于客户视图的列中保存了多于一个的标签列，删除多于的标签列，问题解决。供大家参考。 排查思路 分享一个工单，SR 20230128209106 Portal无法搜索VM。 根据报错的提示，path expression (个人认为可以理解为查询的列)的上限为128。而客户的查询中有”128+N”个path expression。 如果需要进行超过128列的查询，可以尝试通过打开查询，然后运行查询，进入到Azure Resource Graph Explorer 中查看。 注：Azure Resource Graph Explorer 默认会查询账户下所有订阅的信息，如需筛选特定的订阅，可以在查询语句的最后加上一行通过订阅名称或订阅ID筛选特定的订阅。 接着Hana的分享，今天遇到的工单SR 20230321219203 vm的查询功能无法使用，查询条件输入后就报错，报了同样的错误， 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 解决方案： 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Liu Huan 2023-03-21 Zhang Lihong Update 分享一个工单，SR 20230128209106 Portal无法搜索VM。 问题现象： 客户在虚拟机页面搜索虚拟机时会提示以下报错。 报错信息： An error occured when trying to fetch resources. Additional details from the underlying API that might be helpful: Please provide below info when asking for support: timestamp = 2022-12-06T00:56:56.0805411Z, correlationId = ac4c08ee-6ebc-4480-ba41-c0e698486334. (Code: BadRequest) Query is invalid. Please refer to the documentation for the Azure Resource Graph service and fix the error before retrying. (Code: InvalidQuery) The query has 129 path expression, which exceeds the limit of 128. A path expression is a object accessor, e.g., properties['foo']. (Code: TooManyPathExpressions) 问题原因： 根据报错的提示，path expression (个人认为可以理解为查询的列)的上限为128。而客户的查询中有”128+N”个path expression。 解决方案： 通过管理视图à编辑列删除掉多于128的N列后，可以正常搜索。 更多信息： 如果需要进行超过128列的查询，可以尝试通过打开查询，然后运行查询，进入到Azure Resource Graph Explorer 中查看。 注：Azure Resource Graph Explorer 默认会查询账户下所有订阅的信息，如需筛选特定的订阅，可以在查询语句的最后加上一行通过订阅名称或订阅ID筛选特定的订阅。 接着Hana的分享，今天遇到的工单SR 20230321219203 vm的查询功能无法使用，查询条件输入后就报错，报了同样的错误， 发现是由于客户视图的列中保存了多于一个的标签列，删除多于的标签列，问题解决。供大家参考。

searchText: Azure VM Serial Console --Linux 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: VM Operations Section: KB 最近修改: 2024-11-14 17:29:13 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 网络; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 注释掉报错的挂载项 问题现象 / 场景 注释掉报错的挂载项 此时已无法SSH连接 searchText: Linux数据磁盘加密，门户操作不生效 适用范围 / 服务 分类: VM 服务: VM Operations Section: KB 最近修改: 2022-06-24 10:30:58 JD 相关性: Azure IaaS 网络; Azure IaaS 一句话摘要 在开始加密之前，请务必停止可能正在向装载的数据磁盘写入数据的所有服务和进程并将其禁用，使其不会在重新引导后自动重启。 这可能会使文件在这些分区上保持打开状态，从而阻止加密过程重新装载这些分区，导致加密失败。 问题现象 / 场景 在开始加密之前，请务必停止可能正在向装载的数据磁盘写入数据的所有服务和进程并将其禁用，使其不会在重新引导后自动重启。 这可能会使文件在这些分区上保持打开状态，从而阻止加密过程重新装载这些分区，导致加密失败。 当您添加数据磁盘后，并不会主动为数据磁盘加密，请您在做好上述准备工作后。对数据磁盘创建快照备份，确保在加密过程中发生任何意外故障时可以恢复。 2.加密故障排除 背景信息 Zhang Lihong 数据磁盘加密准备工作。 根据官方文档，添加新数据磁盘并将其附加到 VM 并不足以为加密做准备。 在启用加密之前，还必须格式化新附加的磁盘并将其正确装载在 VM 中。 在 Linux 上，磁盘必须使用永久性块设备名称装载在 /etc/fstab 中。 因此，Linux 系统挂载数据磁盘，请您在加密之前使用磁盘的UUID在fstab中进行挂载， 创建条目时，请使用“nofail”选项。 如您之前已经在 磁盘 其他设置 中设置了 OS和数据磁盘加密。 1.先在 扩展+应用程序 中，将AzureDiskEncryptionForLinux卸载。 到 磁盘 其他设置 中 注意事项： 1.加密支持的操作系统和其他要求。 3.对XFS的支持和常见问题 排查思路 针对与您反馈的附加数据磁盘之后，在门户的 虚拟机 – 磁盘 – 其他设置 处，点击 保存 后，提示加密完成，但是实际查看磁盘配置，未能生效的问题。经研究和多次测试，以下步骤供您参考。 如您通过门户操作的话，请参考以下步骤操作。 4.然后，您可以在加密扩展中查看加密进度。 操作步骤 / 命令 然后，您可以使用CLI或者PowerShell加密。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 或者，您可以通过门户操作。 将 加密设置 要加密的磁盘更改为 OS和数据磁盘，并保存。 参考链接 参考文档： 详见： 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） Zhang Lihong 针对与您反馈的附加数据磁盘之后，在门户的 虚拟机 – 磁盘 – 其他设置 处，点击 保存 后，提示加密完成，但是实际查看磁盘配置，未能生效的问题。经研究和多次测试，以下步骤供您参考。 数据磁盘加密准备工作。 根据官方文档，添加新数据磁盘并将其附加到 VM 并不足以为加密做准备。 在启用加密之前，还必须格式化新附加的磁盘并将其正确装载在 VM 中。 在 Linux 上，磁盘必须使用永久性块设备名称装载在 /etc/fstab 中。 参考文档： 因此，Linux 系统挂载数据磁盘，请您在加密之前使用磁盘的UUID在fstab中进行挂载， 创建条目时，请使用“nofail”选项。 详见： 在开始加密之前，请务必停止可能正在向装载的数据磁盘写入数据的所有服务和进程并将其禁用，使其不会在重新引导后自动重启。 这可能会使文件在这些分区上保持打开状态，从而阻止加密过程重新装载这些分区，导致加密失败。 如您之前已经在 磁盘 其他设置 中设置了 OS和数据磁盘加密。 当您添加数据磁盘后，并不会主动为数据磁盘加密，请您在做好上述准备工作后。对数据磁盘创建快照备份，确保在加密过程中发生任何意外故障时可以恢复。 然后，您可以使用CLI或者PowerShell加密。 或者，您可以通过门户操作。 如您通过门户操作的话，请参考以下步骤操作。 1.先在 扩展+应用程序 中，将AzureDiskEncryptionForLinux卸载。 到 磁盘 其他设置 中 将 加密设置 要加密的磁盘更改为 OS和数据磁盘，并保存。 4.然后，您可以在加密扩展中查看加密进度。 注意事项： 1.加密支持的操作系统和其他要求。 2.加密故障排除 3.对XFS的支持和常见问题

EncryptionMethod.XTS256 Encrypt method of the Win32 EncryptableVolume class - Win32 apps Microsoft Docs 客户环境中的原有注册表配置信息如下： Computer\HKEY LOCAL MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\FVE 默认正常的注册表配置信息如下： 参考文档：Windows VM 上的Azure 磁盘加密方案- Azure Virtual Machines Azure Docs 排查思路 portal加密虚拟机OS磁盘和数据磁盘时提示报错 问题排查： 操作步骤 / 命令 未从原文中明确识别。 关键参数 / 状态码 未从原文中明确识别。 根因 / 结论 未从原文中明确识别。 解决方案 解决方案： 在开启Azure磁盘加密之前，如果虚拟机中存在先前部署失败的AzureDiskEncryption扩展，需要先将磁盘加密disable掉，再删除AzureDiskEncryption扩展。 在调整完注册表并重启后，第一次开启磁盘加密时如果报错，建议再执行一次disable磁盘加密-delete扩展的操作，再次尝试开启磁盘加密。 参考链接 未从原文中明确识别。 原始内容清洗稿（保留备查） WangZhaoqing 关联工单：20220622173037 问题现象： portal加密虚拟机OS磁盘和数据磁盘时提示报错 虚拟机满足加密支持条件，向用户索要磁盘测试当作为数据磁盘附加到其它虚拟机上时是可以正常加密的。 问题排查： 加密是虚拟机操作系统日志有警告日志BitLocker问题，客户反馈现象也是虚拟机加入了AzureAD后出现的此问题 通过系统日志可以找到加密失败的原因在于虚拟机加密扩展组件进行加密时，返回如下错误： 2022-07-05T02:47:39.3137155Z [Info]: Win32EncryptableVolumeWrap::GetEncryptionMethod osVer = WindowsServer2016, osBuild = 19042; EncryptionMethod.XTS256 2022-07-05T02:47:39.3293409Z [Error]: Win32EncryptableVolumeWrap::Encrypt failed with 2147942487 通过对该错误的分析，我们怀疑加密失败与系统内部安全策略有关，参考文档如下： Encrypt method of the Win32 EncryptableVolume class - Win32 apps Microsoft Docs 对比了可以正常加密的虚拟机，发现在加密失败的虚拟机上增加了多条用户自定义的安全策略；在参照默认正常的注册表配置信息进行删除之后，磁盘加密的操作可以正确完成。 客户环境中的原有注册表配置信息如下： Computer\HKEY LOCAL MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\FVE 默认正常的注册表配置信息如下： 解决方案： 在开启Azure磁盘加密之前，如果虚拟机中存在先前部署失败的AzureDiskEncryption扩展，需要先将磁盘加密disable掉，再删除AzureDiskEncryption扩展。 参考文档：Windows VM 上的Azure 磁盘加密方案- Azure Virtual Machines Azure Docs 在调整完注册表并重启后，第一次开启磁盘加密时如果报错，建议再执行一次disable磁盘加密-delete扩展的操作，再次尝试开启磁盘加密。
